publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The paper focuses on the optimization of ambulance deployment problem that works as a key attribute in enhancing the service level provided by Emergency Medical Services (EMS). Deployment problem deals with an appropriate distribution of ambulances among the base stations or waiting stations to reduce the Average Response Time (ART) of EMS. Data of base stations, ambulances, and accident prone areas has been collected and analyzed for the city of Delhi. Computations for travel time between demand location and ambulance location has been done using Google Distance Matrix API. Genetic Algorithm has been used for optimizing the results. The results of this work provide an optimal deployment plan by adding nine more ambulances to the current count of ambulances reducing the value of ART by 4.35%. Experiments have been carried out to validate the result obtained.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Automated Service Request Desk for Hotel Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays most organizations in the travel and hospitality industry are facing many problems to improve customer relationships, productivity and profitability. It is very difficult to handle a large number of customers for a customer service support centre through the manual business process. To overcome these issues, automation is a new and intelligent approach for cost optimization, productivity enhancement and drive business growth. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is a form of Business Process Automation (BPA) that automates repetitive, rule-based tasks in business systems. In this manuscript, the process of the Service Request Desk (SRD) for the hotel industry has been automated with the help of Microsoft Power Platform. An automated SRD process results in enhancement in customer relationship management and customer satisfaction in the travel and hospitality industry.

articleTitle: Energy and Resource Consumption in Cryptocurrency Mining: A Detailed Comparison
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cryptocurrency can be a relatively new combination of cryptocurrency and currency in the cash space and is widely used around the globe. However, the entity of the blockchain program area is expected to reshape the renewable energy market for the usability of modern virtual currencies. Therefore, this study makes a specialty of various experiments on mining potency, especially for dogecoin mining. A targeted assessment of carried out a mathematics evaluation of information in an exceptional benchmark and test outcomes of Dogecoin mining is conducted. The goal of this paper is to illustrate the energy consumption and performance of the mining of various cryptocurrencies. The renewable electricity zone could be restructured in blockchain applications. However, research on the use of electricity in digital currencies is lacking. Therefore, nine types of cryptocurrencies and 10 algorithms were examined in this take a look at for mining effectiveness. A comparison was made of statistical data analysis in a Dogecoin mining benchmark and experimental results. This research subsequently provided an estimate of the Dogecoin mining activity's gross electricity consumption. The results show that the hashing algorithm defines primarily the mining performance.

articleTitle: Coronavirus and Pneumonia Detection from X-Ray Images Harnessing Deep Learning and Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: COVID-19 has been spreading quickly across the globe. Some extreme cases have been seen where patients experience the ill effects of pneumonia with coronavirus. COVID-19 along with pneumonia is a serious illness that can be deadly. The aim of classifying COVID-19 pneumonia X-ray images and normal COVID-19 X-ray images achieved in this study. We used the VGG-16 model, which is pre-trained for image classification on a dataset of over 14 million images belonging to 1000 classes. The model developed in this study achieved top-5 test accuracy of 98% in ImageNet. In the proposed approach, we load VGG-16 with chopped top layers. The last dense layers were chopped and fine-tuning is done after keeping already learned weights as initial parameters. We were able to record 97% top-2 accuracy on the finely tuned model.

articleTitle: Consumer Characteristics and Consumption Patterns of Soft Drinks
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A soft drink is generally treated as very common product aimed at a very casual consumption. Normally, not much of attention is paid to this product, which has almost become ‘commoditized’. But, a deeper and more careful observation would reveal that soft drinks are strong demographic descriptors of their consumers. Key insights into the characteristics and consumption patterns of consumers can be obtained through an incisive study of the soft drinks market. This research paper makes a concerted effort at unearthing the demographic details and consumption contours of the soft drink users in Kanpur, Agra, Varanasi, Allahabad, and Lucknow - the five representative cities of Uttar Pradesh, the most populous state of India. It has been conclusively established through this research that the residents of these five cities - which are demographically similar in nature - exhibit varying consumption patterns when it comes to soft drinks. It was also found that demographic variables like age, gender, educational qualification, income, and marital status do not significantly impact the consumption of soft drinks, whereas employment status is a key influencer of the same.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Prediction of Covid-19 using Chest CT Scan
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There has been tremendous distress over the globe since 2019 due to the novel Corona Virus. The COVID-19 disease has caused the medical services a great deal of pressure and a medical emergency all over the world. Very quick dissemination of coronavirus has muzzled as well as endangered human civilization. Various processes have brought attention to the medical propensity for the diagnosis of Corona Virus disease. Antigen and Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) tests have been used since the brisk emergence of COVID-19. The emanation of various mutants developed in these two years has put some questions on the precision and accurate result of these methods especially during the second wave of the pervasive coronavirus. So, various radiological methods like Computed Tomography (CT scan) and X-ray, etc. have been utilized for the spot because of the more meticulous result. The investigatory study in the given paper is about the application of Artificial Intelligence in speculating the coronavirus disease using a suitable model. The research carried out in the given paper gave an accuracy of 99%. Various machine learning-based classifiers are being adapted for the prediction of the disease.

articleTitle: A New Hybrid Approach for Encrypting XML Documents
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper proposes an approach for encrypting XML documents by using the elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) and chaos to overcome the problem of allocating secret keys and to make fast encryption mechanism respectively. The purposes of applying the ECC are to generate and allocate secret keys and the digital signature. The secret keys generated are then used to encrypt the XML documents by using chaos. The applicability of the proposed approach is demonstrated by an experimental example

articleTitle: An Implicit Approach for Visual Data: Compression Encryption via Singular Value Decomposition, Multiple Chaos and Beta Function
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital image compression-encryption scheme based on the theory of singular value decomposition, multiple chaos and Beta function, which uses SVD to compress the digital image and utilizes three way protections for encryption viz. logistic and Arnold map along with the beta function. The algorithm has three advantages: First, the compression scheme gives the freedom to a user so that one can select the desired compression level according to the application with the help of singular value. Second, it includes a confusion mechanism wherein the pixel positions of image are scrambled employing Cat Map. The pixel location is shuffled, resulting in a cipher text image that is safe for communication. Third the key is generated with the help of logistic map which is nonlinear and chaotic in nature therefore highly secured. Fourth the beta function used for encryption is symmetric in nature which means the order of its parameters does not change the outcome of the operation, meaning faithful reconstruction of an image. Thus, the algorithm is highly secured and also saving the storage space as well. The experimental results show that the algorithm has the advantages of faithful reconstruction with reasonable PSNR on different singular values.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Sentiment Analysis Framework for Reliable Feedback System
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In many institutions, feedback collection is either carried out manually or in a generic centralized manner, both of which are prone to manipulation. To provide a legitimate and practical feedback system is still being explored in the area of industry and information security. With an increase in demand for user feedback, concerns on authenticity and privacy of information have grown. This article describes a web-based application implemented on a decentralized approach for building a reliable system that can ensure legitimate feedback. This feedback system provides an online platform to accomplish the whole procedure which is a research field of cryptography with the basics of encryption, hashing and signature algorithms. Further, sentiment analysis has been explored for projecting the cumulative feedback and providing veritable results. This application can be applied in corporate offices and educational institutions where students and employees will be required to submit feedback for the concerned authorities.

articleTitle: Security at Virtualization Level in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cloud computing is perhaps the most energizing advancements today because of its cost decrease, adaptability, and versatility. With the quick development of cloud computing innovation, information security is getting progressively significant. To survey whether to move to cloud computing, it is imperative to think about the advantages and related dangers. Accordingly, security and other existing issues in the cloud imply that cloud clients need more opportunity to consider moving to cloud conditions. Be that as it may, security-related issues are perhaps the most begging to be proven wrong themes in cloud computing, driving a few organizations to take a gander at this innovation uncertainly and to act with alert. Virtualization is the vital segment of cloud computing. The cloud offers a more solid assistance at a lower cost and in this manner lessens equipment framework. With the advancement of PC security in the cloud at the virtual level they become the fundamental issues. For this security issue, an answer dependent on division by success is proposed. The security danger of virtualization is characterized and the arrangement is given dependent on this methodology by giving a faker virtual worker to the whole virtual worker independently, and consequently the security danger can be diminished. In this paper give an overview of the cloud computing, Virtualization, Types of Virtualization and Virtualization security issues.

articleTitle: An Improved Multi-label k-Nearest Neighbour Algorithm with Prototype Selection using DENCLUE
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Prototype Selection (PS) techniques can be implemented very efficiently to allow the nearest neighbor classification to be faster by using a simple method to preserve the most prominent data for the Multi-Label k-Nearest Neighbour (ML-kNN) training. The most often used algorithm for classifying multi-labeled data is ML-kNN data which is adopted through the use of the well-known kNN algorithm. The use of Prototype Selection often minimizes the accuracy, and hence the performance of the algorithm. To solve the problem of reducing the accuracy of the ML-kNN, we proposed a novel solution that reduces data by using the well-known clustering algorithm-DENCLUE. Data that belongs to one of the clusters is considered prominent, while data that does not belong to any of the clusters is considered noisy and will not be included in the training process. In terms of noisy data reduction, the findings demonstrate a significant improvement over the ML-kNN.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Supervised Algorithms With Hyperparameter Tuning on Breast Cancer Dataset
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In a fast-pacing and the advancing world where setting newer targets each day and working for them has become the next big thing in the scenery, we as humans have taken our health factor on second foot or to be honest, we have now become far more lenient and sooner or later we need to pay the price. We have shed shelter to many new diseases, in turn making us pay the price for it. Amongst those, one which has drawn attention from the past few years is Breast Cancer (BC). As a result, we have seen a major increase in the death rate for women especially. It can be broadly be divided into categories Malignant and Benign. Benign is termed as noncancerous (that means it cannot spread to other parts of the body) but, Malignant is the contrary of benign. If it is spotted at the right time treatment can be done. The data-set we are using here is fetched from Wisconsin Cancer data-set. Through the medium of this paper, we aim at using certain machine learning algorithms and python that are tested for best-case parameters(sequentially), to come up with a conclusion for which machine learning algorithm fits best over here in analysing the given cancer data-set for Benign(B) and Malignant(M).

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Major Depressive Disorder: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) is very much pervasive in the present period. MDD is when an episode of discrete behavior sustains for at least two weeks. It is a disorder that develops twice times more in women than men. Many prevalence theories are explained through this review. Few anatomical and physiological changes also have been observed in the brain for MDD patients. The genetic modifications for MDD patients were prominent enough. As MDD has very high morbidity, it should be treated in every possible way. Some of the treatments were described here. Machine Learning (ML) in MDD was overviewed, and also future development scope or areas were discussed. This review covers the fundamental aspects of MDD in a very general way, along with its association with ML techniques.

articleTitle: Objects Relativity Bias: for Detected Objects if they are in the range of their Bigger Compositions
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: As with the access of high-speed internet and powerful handheld smartphones, we are generating enormous amount of video data at unprecedented rate. It will never be possible for human race to process and consume all these videos manually. As technology has equipped us to generate, store and share that amount of data, then technology only can help us to process and consume this much data in sensible duration. So that the processed information can be used when it's required. To do so, computer vision plays the most important role in finding out the useful information from tons of tons of newly created videos by leveraging the computing advancements. Object detection is core requirement for any Computer Vision task. To detect the objects efficiently and effectively, there exists many object detection algorithms. In real world smaller objects combined to form bigger objects and the bigger objects can form some compositions of bigger objects. Hence, Objects Relativity Bias, the term which we used in this paper is to show the importance of the placements of smaller objects with respect to the bigger objects. For example, if we see an image which only contains a wheel, then we get some confidence that this is a wheel is totally dependent on the algorithm which we are using. But if we see two horizontally placed wheels connected through some iron frame with a seat on the frame, paddles between the wheels and a handle above one of the wheels, then we are more confident that the portion of the image which contains wheel are definitely some kind of wheels and specifically wheels of a bicycle. Therefore, this relativity between these objects makes the object detection easier along with higher confidence. So, we termed this relationship confidence as Objects Relativity Bias.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Anomaly Detection Algorithms on Banking data
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this era, use of credit has increased extensively. People are using credit cards more frequently in their daily lives. Millions of dollars were lost in forgery, however fraud detection methods have been developed to fix such types of problems. However, Nevertheless, we still face such problems through imbalance data. There is a requirement for a centralized claims database to collect views of holistic view of fraudulent characteristic behaviour. Credit card supervised learning are widely used to detect fraud based on the assumption that the pattern of fraud would depend on past transaction. This paper will give succinct understanding to avoid such problems. And will elaborate how we can use unsupervised techniques in forgery or fraud detection. In the beginning all the supervised techniques are given, types of anomalies and classification of anomaly detection techniques are given. In addition to that a project is done with the use of raw bank data and forgery is detected with unsupervised techniques.

articleTitle: An approach for Storage Optimized Cloud using AES Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cloud computing (CC) is the next-gen of IT enterprise architecture. Unlike conventional solutions, CC transfers application software and databases to vast data centres, where file and service storage might not be completely reliable. This one-of-a-kind feature, on the other hand, introduces a slew of new security issues that are not well known. Cloud services are distributed across all servers, users, and individuals. As a result, ensuring file confidentiality is difficult for the cloud provider. As a result, an attacker can easily access, misuse, and kill data in its original form. Entrusting cloud is useless in the occurrence of a compromise at any expense. For file information archiving in the cloud, a solution that is “practically infeasible to strike” is needed. This paper uses AES cryptosystem. If the cloud-stored data in encrypted form, it would effectively solve various security issues.

articleTitle: Talking Multimeter and LCR Meter: Accessible for Blind or Visually Impaired Persons(VIPs)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Reading the Values of electric components and parameters is quite a tedious and strenuous task sometimes. Other factors such as the growing popularity and use of very small packaged components and managing inventories of components having unreadable markings worsen the situation. On the extreme end, all these struggles transform into a gigantic hurdle for visually impaired students and electrical/electronic enthusiasts to carry forward their interest in the field. This paper discusses the design of one of the plausible solutions by building and designing one of its kind talking Multimeter and LCR meter that can measure and speak out the value of measured value as and when required.

articleTitle: Estimating the Software Project Effort using Regression based Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Software cost and effort estimation has an important role in the software industry. It leads any project to success or failure due to their variations during the project implementations. There are different techniques that are used for estimating the project. Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and Linear Regression perform in different ways but the results they both generate are almost the same. The aim of this paper is to estimate the effort using the Linear regression and then verify it using the ANOVA and provide the relation between Linear Regression and ANOVA while estimating the software cost.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Automated RoI Extraction and Pattern Classification of Breast Thermograms
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: High mortality rate among women in India is mainly due to breast cancer. As mammography is a standard imaging tool used in screening the breast, it sometimes tends to miss certain abnormalities that lie beneath the breast regions. Thermography being a temperature-based functional imaging modality has enough potential to identify the abnormal changes in the breast through asymmetries at an early stage. This paper considers breast thermograms of patients that are normal and abnormal wherein pre-processing is applied to extract the ROI. The pre-processing includes breast region segmentation using horizontal and vertical projection profile approach along with the Otsu method. The features are then extracted from this ROI for which they are also fed as input to the non-linear classifiers for classification of normal and abnormal. The outcome of the paper results in a good accuracy rate that can be efficiently utilized as a Computer-Aided Detection tool for a second opinion in the breast cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Overview of Smart Grid Systems and their implementation in India
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The advancement in technology creates an exponential demand for electric power, the gap between the power supply and demand is huge. A major portion of this gap is due to power losses in the conventional electrical grids. Conventional electrical grids have multiple problems like equipment failure, energy theft and uneven distribution of energy. These hindrances make electric power expensive and impact the economy. To overcome these hurdles, a smart grid system can be utilized. The smart grid systems significantly increase the efficiency of power generation and distribution and ensures effective utilization of resources. Smart grids increase efficiency by analysing the power consumption data and adjusting power generation according to it. The system helps in determining the efficiency of various equipment of the grid and ensures their timely maintenance, detects and isolates outages, and contains them before they become large scale blackouts.

articleTitle: AGE-SVN: Auction Game based 5G Enabled Smart Vehicular Network using D2D Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Smart communication is essential for the vehicular network where a large number of sensor devices are installed to monitor the vehicles, as well as massive number of peoples who travel on it. In AGE-SVN, we have focused on 5G smart heterogeneous network (HetNet) for vehicular communication with Device-to-Device (D2D) communication technology based on game theory. In AGE-SVN, action game theory is used to allocate spectrum resources to the vehicles. A utility function is proposed through which spectrum manager allocates the resources to the vehicles. The power consumption (PC), Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio (SINR) and spectral efficiency (SE) of the proposed AGE-SVN are calculated and compared it with the previously published network. The proposed AGE-SVN has reduced PC by ~ 12% – 38% and increased SINR and SE by ~11% – 58% and 3% – 20% respectively, from other vehicular network, which is very useful for vehicular communication.

articleTitle: Cocktail - An ARX based Cryptographic Hash Function Designed using Modified ChaCha Core
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cryptographic Hash functions are extensively used to achieve multiple security goals like message integrity and authentication. In this paper, we propose a new simple, flexible and efficient cryptographic hash function - Cocktail, that blends security with speed. Cocktail makes use of Addition, Rotation and XOR operations only and is based on Modified ChaCha core as its core primitive. Cocktail can work on 32-bit as well as 64-bit word size and generate hash output of variable sizes. Cocktail can be used in different other operating modes like HMAC, Randomized hashing, PRF ensemble etc. Cocktail can achieve considerably high level of parallelism. This paper presents the Cocktail's specifications, design philosophy, security aspects, usage and performance comparison with SHA-3 winner and other SHA-3 finalists.

articleTitle: Designing a Security Framework for Enhancement of Electronic Transactions
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: With the popularity of e-commerce websites, online transaction options have too gained prominence among customers. Ensuring security is still a major issue that professionals focus on. Though digital transactions enhance customer-merchant experience, there are various risks and challenges involved. Existing techniques such as Address Verification System (AVS), Card Verification Value (CVV), etc. help in verifying customer authenticity. From a customer's perspective, there are no authentication frameworks that will inform them about dishonest merchants. This paper suggests a system model that will use interactive modules to generate a Trust Factor (TF) which will help in detecting fraudulent merchant accounts at financial institutions. This financial technology will generate reports that can be used for analysis to understand the behavior of fraud activities in real time using sophisticated machine learning algorithms, thereby, mitigating merchant and transactional frauds.

articleTitle: Post Covid-19 Scenario: A Study of Shifting Paradigm in Teaching -A Detailed Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this work, the authors have carried out the analysis of the performance of different modes of online learning platforms using statistical tool, which have been applied in the post Covid 19 scenario. In the pandemic situation of corona virus, the mode of teaching has been online learning mode in almost all of the institutions in India, where internet facility is available. Therefore, in this study, we tried to analyse the different online learning platforms and the learning management system to seek the information about the user's preference, especially among the teaching fraternity (i.e., teachers at college level) using statistical analysis tools. In the present study, the efficacy of different online platform is also assessed by statistical analysis tools and comparison is made among them.

articleTitle: Socialization between Quarantine Vehicle and Road Side Unit for Handling COVID-19: A Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The large-scale outbreak of pandemic COVID 19 has escalated the number of calls made to the Emergency Medical Services (EMS). EMS consists of the list of isolation centres and quarantine vehicles that are supposed to shift patients to isolation centres. The prime motive of the EMS is to provide quick and reliable assistance to the victims so that their exposure to other public is as low as possible. In this paper, we propose a novel concept of Socially Connected Quarantine Vehicle (SCQV) a subset of Social Internet of Vehicles (SIoV). The SCQV is a social network established among the quarantine vehicles and roadside units. It can be used for shifting the patients to isolation centres or hospitals and circulating messages regarding emergency help and formation of containment zone among people. The concept is new in its context where the socially and mutually connected entities will be capable of interacting with each other and make the handling of patients efficient.

articleTitle: Green Mining for Android Based Applications Using Refactoring Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The need for green programming arrangement is consistently becoming greater particularly with regards to cell phones., where the control is frequently restricted by battery life. Green mining is the part of programming designing liable for distinguishing the causes for “energy leaks””., correspondingly for the reasonable solutions to manage them. A few significant exploration steps have been made and regardless of the ever-expanding number of observational investigations pointed toward understanding the explanations for the presence of energy-leaks in the source code. These smells offer a bunch of unpleasant programming practices in Android applications. The paper aims to provide a more extensive connection among smells and energy proficiency and calculate energy utilization for android apps and make “energy-aware refactoring approach for Mobile Apps””. The results show that dreadful number of code-smells are present in the applications., hence., its needed to be removed and correspondingly may result in much better functioning of applications.

articleTitle: A 0.28 GHz to 3.84 GHz low power differential ring oscillator design using cross-coupled transistors for radio frequency identification (RFID)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This article presents a low-power wider tuning range differential ring oscillator for a reader-less RFID trans receiver that is IEEE 802.11b/g, Zigbee, and Bluetooth protocol compliant. A differential delay cell with cross coupled transistors has been used to design the proposed differential ring oscillator (DRO). The proposed DRO with a 1.2 V power supply is designed using a 90 nm CMOS technology. This DRO works in the tuning range of 0.280 GHz to 3.843 GHz (172% tuning range) with a power dissipation of 0.212 mW to 0.867 mW. This DRO exhibits a phase noise of −85.08 dBc (decibels relative to the carrier)/Hz@1MHz offset and a figure-of-merit of −164.24 dBc/Hz at the centre frequency. Process corner, temperature swept, and Monte Carlo analysis has been executed on the proposed design to ensure its stability and compatibility. The proposed DRO achieved the best performance-area trade-off and will be an important module for active RFID transponder.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning Algorithms for Discerning the Presence of Pneumonia
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Pneumonia is a fatal disease that involves inflammation of the air sacs in the lungs, resulting in breathing difficulties. As a result, early discovery of the condition is critical, as it can be deadly in its later stages, leading to respiratory issues. Chest X-rays have long been used to reliably diagnose Pneumonia. Human-assisted diagnosis, on the other hand, has constraints such as the availability of an expert and involves significant expenditures for the necessary equipment. As a result, there has been a spike in demand for alternative methods for identifying pneumonia from chest x-rays using Deep Learning. To aid this, the usage of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and other classification algorithms has increased and is now being used in important decision-making processes in the medical profession. This paper compares several convolutional neural network architectural models such as VGG-16, InceptionV3, DenseNet169, and CNN for identifying the presence of pneumonia using chest x-ray images, and finally, the models have been evaluated using performance metrics for better analysis.

articleTitle: Early Breast Cancer Diagnosis and Risk Prediction based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Breast cancer is a disease in which life-threatening (malignant) cells in the breast multiply out of hand, making it the second most fatal type of cancer in women widely. Hence, to diminish the mortality rate and increasing the chances of survival, it is crucial to uncover it as early as attainable. This paper focused on comparing the different classifiers which are support vector machine, naïve Bayes, and K-nearest neighbor algorithms using the DDSM dataset. The target of this computer-aided system is to combine these classification techniques with image pre-processing methods so to compare their performance to find out the most satisfactory approach. The crux is to use the advantages of these techniques to obtain maximum optimal performance. For the comparative study, the digital mammogram of the breast is passed to histogram equalization for image pre-processing which enhances the necessary feature while removing noise that is present in the mammogram, the refined mammograph is then passed to wavelet transformation to extract all the important features for the classification.

articleTitle: Implementation of Efficient Test Case Optimization Technique Using Meta-Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Testing in software is based on detect bugs. This is the fundamental advance of the Software improvement life cycle. In the testing we compare results with predicted results to guarantee that our program is free of bugs or not. It also helps to recognize mistakes and incomplete provision. Test case optimization is used to diminish the effort needed to test the modification by detecting the correct test required for the test cycles. In this rag, we present the Genetic-Cuckoo Algorithm, a job planning algorithm for lattice. This research work proposes a hybrid approach for the optimization of the test case, which offers the best possible solutions. The proposed approach is giving better results from the previous methods in context to the accuracy. In this paper, the proposed algorithm shows the accuracy of hybrid approach with comprising of genetic and cuckoo approach.

articleTitle: A Complete Study on Malware Types and Detecting Ransomware Using API Calls
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Due to advancement in technology, cybersecurity attacks are increasing day by day. So, to secure the data and information, Malware analysis is introduced as a new methodology which is the process of understanding the behavior and purpose of a suspicious file or URL. The output of the analysis helps in the detection and mitigation of the potential threat. This novel solution is based on cybersecurity, which can be used in window applications, File scans, URL scans, and link scans. This paper describes different types of malwares and a solution for securing the data by detecting ransomware using API calls.

articleTitle: Audio Detection using Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The lack of benchmark findings for comparison with any suggested approach is one of the most fundamental challenges in sound event detection research. Distinct research explore different sets of events and datasets, making it difficult to distinguish between new and existing methods. We calculated the average accuracy and mean AUC using the ESC 50 dataset in this research. We employ a Gaussian Mixture model-based component depiction explicitly and solidify it with linear and non-linear Support Vector Machines.

articleTitle: Brain Image Segmentation based on U-Net Architecture with Adaptive Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, a brain tumor segmentation method has been proposed. Image segmentation is required for the detection of brain tumors. For this purpose, brain images are divided into two distinct areas. This is one of the main but also the most complex element of the tumor identification process. A brain tumor is a result of mass of tissue that grows, it is the most important cause of the increased mortality rate among children as well as adults. This paper proposes a brain tumor segmentation method by using a combination of Adaptive Histogram Equalization and U-Net architecture. The performance of U-Net architecture and U-Net Architecture with Adaptive Histogram Equalization Technique are contrast by using PSNR (Peak Signal to Noise Ratio), MSE (Mean Squared Error), Quality and Complexity parameters. Overlap-tile strategy is used to smooth the segmentation of large images. Many MR images were collected, and the observations were carried out for statistical analysis using the Adaptive Histogram Equalization and U-Net architecture.

articleTitle: Development of Paper with Dhaincha Fiber (Sesbania aculeata)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The current study revolves around development of paper from dhaincha fiber (Sesbania aculeata). Dhaincha is a basically cultivated for improvisation of soil quality. Due to deforestation worldwide, various sources of raw materials are used in paper industries. Indian pulp and paper industry is the world's major paper industry. In this study extraction of dhaincha fiber was done followed by retting, combing, chemical analysis and by making of pulp with dhaincha fiber. The dhaincha pulp was then used for making a paper from dhaincha fiber. The thickness of the dhaincha paper was then tested with paper thickness tester. By doing further processing dhaincha paper can be used commercially by paper industry.

articleTitle: Enhancing Protection Accuracy of a 220kV Afghanistan Transmission Line Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The transmission line in Electrical Engineering transfer the power throughout different environmental topology and chances of fault accidence is more as other part of the electrical power system. Currently 73% of Electric Power in Afghanistan is an imported Electric power and this power is supplying from nearby country as 27% power is from Tajikistan, 17% from Iran, 25% from Turkmenistan and 4% from Uzbekistan. So that this power is transferred over long distance and different location of devices and layout of the cables and these differences lead the transmission line to experience the fault mostly. As to protect and prevent more occurrences of the fault conventional and traditional method is already excited but still percentage of fault accidence and power losses are so high due to delayed identification of the fault(Detection and classification). Artificial intelligence is crucial to avoid damage in the system as quickly as possible and enhance the protection system. There are various artificial intelligence has introduced in modern power Transmission line to identify a fault (fault detection and fault classification) in overhead transmission line. In this paper ANNs is proposing for Afghanistan transmission line to detect and classify occurrence of the faults in 220kV overhead transmission line. Thus the neural network can be train with offline data and this property of the network makes differentiate the system from conventional method and make the system reliable and efficient. MATLAB /Simulink 2020a software is used to train neural network and configure three phase 220kV transmission line.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Clustering Scheme to Improve the Lifespan of WSN
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) has been used in many areas like healthcare, defense, disaster, agriculture, etc. in the various application based on WSN have one BS and many numbers of the sensor device to monitor pressure-temperature in various environment condition. wsn consist of small tiny devices called sensor nodes (SNs) having few limitations in stipulations of sensing range and battery. There are numerous parameter plays an important role for designing an effective protocol of WSN to improve the lifespan of WSN. To minimize the energy dissipation of the SN and enhance the lifespan of the wireless sensor networks is a big issue. This article proposed a protocol to increase the lifespan of WSN using CH selection. The selection of CH is based on the distance to BS, residual energy, and node density. CH selection aims to reduce energy utilization and enhance the lifespan of WSN as compare to HEED and SEP protocol.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Design for Process Liquid Level System
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In order to control the daily functioning in process control industries, various controllers are used. The liquid level control system is one such application in industrial control systems. This work focuses on modelling and simulation of three tank liquid level system connected in interactive design mode using different controllers. The controllers used are PI, PID & Optimal Controller. PI controller serves as the best controller to obtain response fastly. PID control has the advantage of fast response along with no offset time. Optimal Controller helps in getting the best performance for given system. The MATLAB output results have been compared in terms of performance evaluation parameters viz. Rise time, overshoot, steady state error, settling time. From the comparison of simulation results, this is observed that PID controller gives far better results with reduction in steady state error to large extent. This ensures efficacy of Proportional Integral Derivative controller over the PI and Optimal Controller in three tank system.

articleTitle: A Radio Model for Precise Estimation of Lifetime for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The lifetime of a sensor node in a sensor network depends mainly upon power consumed during transmission, reception, listening and computation. Proper estimation of lifetime for a sensor network is possible if an exhaustive radio model is used for the same. Radio models used for a sensor network must include duty cycle of the node for correct estimation of lifetime. Along with this, power consumed for computation is also to be considered for proper estimation of network lifetime. Moreover, change in parameter like neighbor density may also affect the lifetime, by keeping all other parameters same. Here we propose a radio model that along with other necessary parameters, addresses the variation of duty cycle for computing the network lifetime. With this radio model, we calculate the variation in lifetime when neighbor density of the network changes.

articleTitle: Data Analysis and Energy Consumption Characteristics of EV with Real Driving Cycles
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Energy consumption plays an important role in determining the efficiency of electric vehicles. This research aims to collect the data of the vehicle and classify features based on driving situations to study the parameters of Indian roads. The transient drive cycles further help in computing the energy consumption by a particular vehicle at an instance of time. The energy consumption at every instance of time is calculated by calculating different features as motor torque, motor speed, Battery SOC, and battery current which further helps in determining the issue in the efficiency of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Microstrip Rectangular Patch Antenna for Wireless Communication by Inset Feed Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Frequency reconfigurable microstrip rectangular patch antenna by using inset feeding technique for wireless communication is showcased here. The proposed antenna is developed by introducing square-patch of 2 mm width at top corners. The upper part behaves like a parasitic patch for the main radiator. PIN diode is used to provide electrical conductivity between the parasitic patch and main patch. A proper DC biasing is introduced for switching ON and OFF the diode, the operating frequency of the antenna can be varied from onboard computer for two different frequency bands. The full patch antenna is operating at frequency 16.50 GHz with -30.65 dB return loss. The same antenna with parasitic patches at the two corners for different biasing states of PIN-diode provides two different resonance frequencies. In OFF states of PIN-diodes, it works at 12.75GHz and 18.00 GHz with -27.45 dB and -33dB return loss respectively, whereas in ON states it resonates at 5.5GHz (-31dB) and 18GHz (-33dB). The antenna can be applicable for radar surveillance and satellite communication.

articleTitle: E-Kranti: Overview of electronic service delivery
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Digital India is an ambitious plan by the Indian government to transform India into a digital society. The priority areas are: to create a digital infrastructure that is useful to all citizens across the country, and to ensure good governance on-demand services and citizens' digital authorization. The mission of the Digital India Project is to prepare India for the future of knowledge by making technology a central role in achieving change. Digital India is based on nine pillars: broadband, universal mobile access, public Internet access, technology-driven governance reforms, E-Kranti, information for all, electronics manufacturing, employment IT and early harvest programs, these are digital legacy capabilities These documents can provide a platform for all scholarships provided by the Indian government, from simplified online registration and hospitalization appointments to the widespread use of signatures, from the establishment of a national flexible electronic center to the establishment of an electronic development foundation (from the establishment of an electronic foundation) across the country The optical fiber backbone network infrastructure to develop next-generation networks heralds the convergence of voice, data and multimedia services. Digital India is the most comprehensive plan currently being implemented, aiming to use the huge potential of digital technology to push India forward.

articleTitle: The Study of Various Methodologies in the Development of Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Recommendation systems are becoming very popular due to their intelligence in recommending products or items to users or customers or consumers. Particularly, this concept became more popular due to E-commerce sites as these sites will attract customers by providing recommendations. In this article, the proposed framework deal with the development of recommendation systems using the methodologies such as priority-based recommendation systems, collaborative filtering recommendation systems, and user-item-based recommendation systems. The results obtained with these methodologies have also been mentioned in this article.

articleTitle: Image Enhancer
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Image processing is done using machine learning algorithms and tools like OpenCV (short for Open Computer Vision). This research paper shows an improved and convenient approach towards processing of images. Images that are highly distorted by any means or noise are too common in todays' era. This problem can rise by too many reasons be it transmitting from one source to another, by physical device damages, signals poor decoding from the source and even the noise from the sensor of the device they are taken. Prior to the invention of computers and applications such as Photoshop, these jobs were clearly performed only by experts with extensive knowledge in these areas. They mainly used to process physical copies of the images like enhancing the images by brushing techniques. For eliminating undesired noises and thus providing higher image quality, a new decision-based filtering strategy combining K-means and PCA is proposed. Now a days, there are various filters available in many free editing tools that surely do enhance the quality of the image the way you want them to be.

articleTitle: AI & ML Based Anamoly Detection and Response Using Ember Dataset
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the era of rapid technological growth, malicious traffic has drawn increased attention. Most well-known offensive security assessment todays are heavily focused on pre-compromise. The amount of anomalous data in today's context is massive. Analyzing the data using primitive methods would be highly challenging. Solution to it is: If we can detect adversary behaviors in the early stage of compromise, one can prevent and safeguard themselves from various attacks including ransomwares and Zero-day attacks. Integration of new technologies Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning with manual Anomaly Detection can provide automated machine-based detection which in return can provide the fast, error free, simplify & scalable Threat Detection & Response System. Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) tools provide a unified view of complex intrusions using known adversarial behaviors to identify intrusion events. We have used the EMBER dataset, which is a labelled benchmark dataset. It is used to train machine learning models to detect malicious portable executable files. This dataset consists of features derived from 1.1 million binary files: 900,000 training samples among which 300,000 were malicious, 300,000 were benevolent, 300,000 un-labelled, and 200,000 evaluation samples among which 100K were malicious, 100K were benign. We have also included open-source code for extracting features from additional binaries, enabling the addition of additional sample features to the dataset.

articleTitle: Analysing the Impact of Climate Change on The Crop Yields of Irrigated Crops and their Water Requirements in India Using Neuro Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Global food security, facing the threat of climate change, is one of the major challenges of the 21st century for sustainability that is already under scrutiny with adequate food security for population growth. Current challenges include water shortages, unaffordable costs due to production and demand, and unpredictable weather conditions. They urged farmers to provide improved farming. In particular, uncertainty about climate change, lack of irrigation facilities, lack of land resources, and lack of crops from traditional farming techniques. In agriculture. Different machine learning techniques such as perception, division, regression, and aggregation are used to predict crops. Artificial networks, vector support systems, linear and linguistic lines, decision trees, and Bayesian intelligence are some of the mathematical methods used to implement the prediction. Obviously, choosing the right algorithm for the sample design algorithms presents a challenge for researchers about the selected plants. In this work, research has been conducted on how many algorithms of machine learning can help predict the dissolution of crops. Methods have been developed to generate predictions. Use machine learning technology in a large computer control system.

articleTitle: Dual Band and Polarised Cross STDA MIMO System for the Base Station Antenna for 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A novel dual polarized cross STDA for the base station 5G application is presented in this paper. The resonant frequency of the proposed antenna is 3.3 to 3.8 GHz and 4.8 to 5 GHz with average realized gain 24 dBi and 26.5 dBi in the upper band and lower band respectively with the stable radiation pattern. It consists of two circular tapered dipole antennas with parasites element feed with adjusted balun system. In this design feed point are shifted along with the balun feed by adjustment. The three-dimensional cross-sectional area is 68 × 68 × 94 mm.

Author Keywords: High gain and Low mutual coupling element

articleTitle: Controlled Risk Pairs Trading using ReinforcementLearning
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the light of current boom in the stock market and deviation from the fundamentals, every investor is worried about formation of a bubble and about the dire consequences that will follow when the bubble bursts. One solution is to avoid capital markets and park money in safe instruments like bank fixed deposits. However, given the low interest rate environment we are in, this option would not be financially savvy. Secondly, one can opt for portfolio management services but that would incur heavy management fees depending on the type of fund one chooses. Efficient management of wealth is very crucial in order to fulfil one's financial goals. All strategies of trading require a significant amount of time and research to determine a trade that would be worth the risk. Sometimes, even after spending hours on research, one might not be able to find an opportunity with an optimum risk-reward ratio. However, it might not be possible for working professionals to devote so much time every day to identify the right trades. With a view to solving this problem, we have built a model using reinforcement learning which will provide users with buy-sell signals based on the theme of pairs trading. Pairs Trading is a relatively safer strategy that tries to create a market neutral position, thereby providing a hedge to some extent against violent market movements.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Lung segmentation for Chest X Ray images using XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Beta version of the corona virus with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (sara-Cov-2) has been identified at many places. Last year virus causes lung involvement like pneumonia named as corona virus disease (COVID 19) with strange etiology. Since this was e quite new virus no further tested drug is available due to the disease nodality there was nothing much available for patients' line of treatment. For curing the such unknown viral disease only possible solutions if to break the chain of infections. BY social distancing and test on the larger cluster can only be the hit method to cure such chains. Tomography in radiology is the diagnostic way to identify the disease at earlier stage. Clinical decisions can made on the basis of the CT and Chest X-ray images are the good means of identification of the corona virus. X - Ray scanning is economically available at most of the places even at remote areas so that general propel can also be benefitted by the early detection of the disease. People are acquiring a tool for the disease detection. In this paper report on investigation study on the all-possible means for cause of corona virus. In this paper we have proposed an automatic method for novel corona virus diagnosis by Chest X- ray images are proposed here. Proposed model XGBoost is based on the convolutions layered fashion deeply. By this proposed model we got the 90 percent accuracy of the testing data. Analysis is done on the comparative study of the XGBoost results and the already existing models results. By comparison we got the proposed method produces the better results as earlier models. Thus, proposed method can be used as effective means for the diagnosis of the corona virus.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Recurrent Neural Network variants to predict yield of Wheat crop in Punjab region
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Yield prediction of a crop prior to harvest is an important aspect of agriculture. The alarming rate at which the population of the world is increasing is making it necessary to take measures to increase the yield of major food crops. The advancements in the area of data sciences especially in the field of machine learning and deep learning has come up as a major breakthrough in the area of crop yield prediction. The ability of deep learning to perform accurate predictions even in the areas with huge and diverse natured data has made it the most sort after technique for predictions in agriculture. There are many agriculture based regions in India where the efficiency of these advanced techniques is still not fully utilized in the field of crop yield prediction. The objective of the present study is to evaluate the efficiency of variants of Recurrent Neural Network, to predict the yield of Wheat crop for a region of Punjab state in India.

articleTitle: Rating of Online Courses: A Machine Learning Based Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Online courses market has provided an economical and easy access to knowledge. When it comes to make a decision related to purchase of online course, little is known about what attributes can be depended upon to guess the quality of an online course. Ratings for online courses act as a reliable signal for assessing the quality of a course. The study discusses the prediction of ratings for online courses using Artificial Neural Network based on Particle Swarm Optimization (ANN-PSO). The experimental results suggests that ANN-PSO model has the capacity to predict the ratings for online courses on the basis of its attributes with accuracy.

articleTitle: Workflow Automation of Routing Rules in the Accounting Process for Online Travel Agency
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Robotic process automation (RPA) provides many benefits in business process management. Handling a large number of customer's requests for booking or refunding is difficult for Online Travel Agency (OTA) through the manual business process. To overcome these issues, RPA provides many benefits for OTA. It is helpful in managing tasks of businesses and increasing the efficiency. The manual work of accounting and refunds in online travel agency can be done by automation which leads business to get the efficient results. In the proposed study, it has been taken into consideration how RPA can be used in refunding process and how it is beneficial for the business. Automating the business processes by using Microsoft Power Platform leads to enhancement in productivity, cost optimization, error reduction and provide business growth for the organizations.

articleTitle: Crowd Density Teller using Infrared Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The proposed paper aims to provide a solution for people gathering and help to maintain social distancing in the era of novel coronavirus. Especially, people who are health conscious will get a sovereign remedy from being infected. This invention will count and show the number (on the online platform) of persons present at any outlet or surrounded place using Infrared Technology after every specific time interval. People can make a quick decision whether to visit now or later or can book their slot in advance. Infrared sensors will be installed on both sides facing each other on the entry and exit gates of any kind of surrounded place like a store, outlet, restaurant, etc. The use of those sensors on entry gates will be to count the number of times its path obstructed and give result as +1, similarly sensors on the exit gates will give result as -1 every time their path gets obstructed and show the final calculated result of how many numbers of person are there inside on the online platform (website/application) which can be accessed by anyone anytime and from anywhere.

articleTitle: A Framework on Cognitive-Based Green Communication Technology to Reduce the Emission of CO2 in the System
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Over the most recent couple of years due to the exponential expansion of the portable media transmission industry, the look and simulation for a framework supported cognitive-based inexperienced communication technology to scale back the emission of carbonic acid gas within the system has been needed. This work is completed to decrease the inexperienced house gas effects as these gasses are seriously harmful for the setting as they cause warming associated so making an unbalance in nature.

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Sink Mobility on Fault Tolerance and Delay in Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) has become an integral part of the Internet of Things (IoT) era thereby. Due to the movements of the human body, the properties of WBAN radio propagation are dynamic and therefore the entire process of communication between nodes and sink develops a big challenge. Nodes existing near to the static sink are always seemed to be busy in data transmission due to which node exhausts its energy much before than the nodes existing away from the sink. Sink mobility serves the above-mentioned challenge. To evaluate the performance of WBAN we have presented two mobility models i.e., i) Random Waypoint Mobility Models (RWM) and ii) Random Direction Mobility Models (RDM) with static and movable sink and Network Simulator 2.35 is used for simulation of the models. The Models are evaluated on the following parameters; Packet Delivery Ratio, Average End-to-End delay, overall Energy consumption, Average Throughput.

articleTitle: Frequency Diversified Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna for Microwave Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A frequency diversified microstrip antenna having rectangular geometry by using inset feeding method is proposed in this paper. The upper part behaves like a parasitic patch for the main radiator. The main patch also consists of a rectangular thin patch at the corner of the lowest part. By applying proper DC biasing to turn on/off the pin diode switches between the parasitic and main patch, the operating frequency of the proposed structure may be changed electronically for the separate bands, and then return loss and beam pattern simulated at the resonating frequencies. The patch antenna structure with switch ON and OFF state gives operating frequency at 2.47 GHz with the return loss of -18.36 dB and 1.8 GHz with return loss of - 20.67 dB.

articleTitle: Impact of using RoSCA on Women Empowerment (with reference to Delhi NCR)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Over decades microfinance is a popular source for women empowerment and researchers have proved the positive impact for the same. Now, the reach of microfinance is not only limited to rural poor but has also reached the urban residents as well. There are different financing options like formal and informal. This paper is about the Empowerment of Urban Women using an informal credit system that is the Rotating Savings and Credit Association (RoSCA)This model of RoSCA is widely accepted in Islamic countries and also getting very popular in other nations as well. The variables like usage of amount saved using RoSCA, financial confidence, their experience after participating in RoSCA, their personal meets with other members, their feel of empowerment are being studied on the members of RoSCA. A theoretical framework is constructed with the help of data that categorize the purchasing preference of RoSCA members. The data is collected from women participants of RoSCA. The study employed questionnaire and worked with the total sample of 200 Women members.

articleTitle: A Formal Approach for Implementing Security Constraints in Security Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Security patterns are being used in software applications to mitigate attacks occurring due to software vulnerabilities. However, developer sometimes overlooks best practices while implementing the security pattern in the software application. In this paper, authors propose a formal approach to describe various security constraints using first order predicate logic. This will facilitate the detection of security vulnerabilities at the early stages of software development life cycle. The approach has been verified using Secure Factory Pattern. The effectiveness of the approach has been further validated using Library Management System as a case study. The proposed approach will help in detection of hidden vulnerabilities in software applications.

articleTitle: A Review on Video Authentication Technique Exploiting Watermarking Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The immense quantities of information is uploaded and downloaded on the internet causing society to accept everything it sees as true without questioning its integrity, security and privacy, and authentication. There are many different methods and techniques, which are suggested for overcoming these problems. it will help a lot to restrict the modified use of the content developed by the creator. With this, the creator can track anybody else's claim for the content, illegal distribution of the content. This paper throws light on some techniques used for video authentication by several authors.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Predictability of Human Emotion in Psychology
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays the trauma of mental sickness has consumed people and their lives a lot. Humans face's numbers of problems, lot of stress and a lot of issues which sometimes they unable to share with the family members and friends due to the fear of misjudged, and humans likes to maintain privacy about their concerns and do not want anyone to interfere in their matters easily. Many times, this is the reason for a rise in the mental health related traumas and sicknesses. The rise of AI was of huge significance, many scientists had something or the other to contribute to the technology. The robots which are AI enabled have more intelligence as compared to all humans. In this paper, we highlight to put forward reasons supporting the use of AI in the field of psychology.

articleTitle: The Data Fusion Models in Underwater Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The advancement of the underwater Wireless Sensor Network (UWSNs) has drawn emerges consideration of numerous researchers from industry and scholars to sense and monitor the unexplored underwater area which is nearly 70% of the earth. Regardless of the striking impact of the sea on worldwide living life forms, it is viewed as that 95% of its ability stays obscure by natural eyes. This issue can be tackled by constant data recovery to people. Underwater communication is an emergent terminology for monitoring and discovery of underwater resources. This network enables for determining the uncovered sources like sank ships, Bermuda triangle trouble, oil mines, and plate tectonics within the water. The unearthing of those resources is tough due to the distant underwater obscure areas. This manuscript discusses the data fusion concept in UWSN with the help of related work. Further, the challenges of UWSNs data fusion are presented. Additionally, different existing data fusion methods are discussed through NS2 w.r.t. different QoS parameters like network lifetime, packet loss rate, energy consumption, delay, packet delivery ratio are considered in these simulations. Finally, the upcoming challenges and open issues during data fusion techniques are deliberated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Data Mining Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Data Mining offers wide range of approaches for extracting information from data. In the medical area, data mining may be utilised to anticipate diagnoses sooner and with more consistent and reliable findings by evaluating the massive amounts of data accessible. In this paper, WEKA (Waikato Environment for Knowledge Analysis) is used which is a toolkit of machine learning algorithms for tasks of data mining. WEKA is a visualization tool that comprises a variety of tools and algorithms such as Naive Bayes, Decision tree, Multilayer Perceptron and j48 classifier for addressing real-world data mining issues and assisting in forecasting. In this work, Pima Indians Diabetes Database is utilized which is gathered from National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases for classification to enhance precision, recall, f-measurement, and accuracy.

articleTitle: A Recent Survey on 6G Vehicular Technology, Applications and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the future, the majority of vehicles could be intelligent and autonomous. In order to achieve this, the 6G will play a predominant role in vehicular technology. Moreover, the next generation 6G wireless communication is an emerging technology that will revolutionize vehicular technology. In future, the new 6G technology is expected to connect more devices in our world. So, it needs to provide excellent performance over recent state of the art communication technology like 5G. The primary features of 6G technology are heterogeneous object connectivity, low power consumption, high throughput, high data reliability, ultra-low latency. Furthermore, it will provide intelligent and secure communication with the help of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Block-chain technology. First, this paper presents the introduction of 6G technology. Later, we discuss the 6G enabling technology, which includes Internet of Everything (IoE), AI and Edge intelligence. Then, this paper mainly concentrates on how to help 6G based vehicular communication in various vehicular applications. Finally, we address the various research challenges on 6G based vehicular communication. Thus, it will be helpful for future research to carry out in the right direction.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient Agent Aware Proactive Fault Tolerance for Preventing Deterioration of Virtual Machines Within Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays, Cloud Computing is widely adopted in current scenario for both personal and professional usage. With advent of technology, large scale usage and increasing growth of cloud computing resources has led to an important issue which is cloud service reliability and high energy consumption. The major issue in cloud computing is data availability, backup replication, data efficiency and reliability because of the failures encountered during the execution. So, for ensuring reliability and availability and limit the use of energy in cloud a technique for fault tolerance must be developed. Presently two main types of fault tolerant techniques such as proactive and reactive fault tolerance are available. In the existing fault tolerant techniques, the focus is mainly on the way to tolerate fault but co-ordination between VMs is missing. Reactive fault tolerance techniques work only after fault is encountered i.e., the system is diagnosed after fault occurs and these techniques lower the effects of faults. To overcome this problem, we first allocate tasks to the virtual machines by using concept of Hot Queues and Cold Queues to reduce total energy consumption and allocating the load among VMs in such a manner that no task goes into starvation state. In this paper agent-based monitoring mechanism is proposed to dynamically monitor the running statistics of all jobs running on VMs. Moreover, our agent-based monitoring system is able to resolve the problem of deteriorating Virtual Machine. In case deterioration is detected, migration is initiated causing high fault tolerance rate and Performance optimization in terms of overhead and execution time, energy efficiency is observed.

articleTitle: Robotic Process Automation in Banking and Finance Sector for Loan Processing and Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The world is evolving into a digitally advanced environment. Transformation is a constantly evolving process where Robotic Process Automation or RPA came into the process of renovation. RPA has recently become a valuable tool in banking and financial institutions. RPA has shown a lot of various benefits for different organizations. The primary intention of Robotic Process Automation in banking is to reduce repetitive tasks in the bank. In banking and various other organizations, RPA has helped reduce the operational costs by 30% - 70%; RPA helps reduce the workforce by employing Bot workers in charge, which later saves the operating costs and increases efficiency and accuracy of the tasks. Lenders are regularly facing pressure to reduce the prices as well as to reduce and save time. Lender hence switches into automation for better efficiency and accuracy of service. With automation bots, lenders can automate loan processing by collecting customer information, loan approval, loan monitoring, and automatic loan pricing. This can be achieved with the help of rule-based software bots. Also, many of the lenders do some part of the process partially automated and some part manually.
