The system is connected with cascode and overall gain is high, takes few transistors for design of a cascode amplifier. A SR can allow frequency up to the range for that will eliminates unwanted signal. A unity gain bandwidth is applied to eliminate smaller signal. A SR of complementary FC amplifier is good at 3.3V/µs where as 6.3V/µs is for recycling folded cascode amplifier. The power consumption is 690µW and 710µW of complementary folded cascode and recycling folded cascode amplifier respectively. The voltage gain is above 70.7% of is considered as amplification for all ranges of its amplitude.

articleTitle: A Study of Awareness and Perception of Augmented Reality in Education Sector
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This study will give the detail understanding of Augmented Reality and the existence of Augmented Reality in the education sector. This paper will also be contributing in understanding that how much user's and teachers are aware about this technology and how many of them have experienced the technology. This study is also giving review on implementation of AR technology and how this is giving benefits to users in different subjects and at different ages as compare to traditional mode of learning. Paper will also help readers in understanding about the perception of users and teachers if they have experienced AR in learning, teaching simultaneously and further scope of research with certain limitations.

articleTitle: Comparison between Code Clone Detection and Model Clone Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In software, clones are syntactically or semantically identical of two code fragments. Cloning by either deliberately or by coincidence. Cloning has pros and cons in software development. Bug propagation may be caused by cloning from original to copied segments. Cloning may lead to difficulties in software maintenance. Cloning is helpful in many functions like code reusability, inheritance, and libraries. Software developers before scripting the code design the model for it. Cloning can exist at any stage either at the design or coding phase, which influences on development, quality, and maintenance of the software. All software has constraints like budget and time are associated. In software development, life cycle budget and time constraints depend on irregularity and risk. These irregularities and risks can be minimized by identifying clones. There are different kinds of clones in Code and Model. In this paper, we present a concise summary of design and coding phase clone detection of these irregularities and risk as well as their for's and against of code clone detection and model clone detection.

articleTitle: Quantum Internet: An Approach towards Global Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A revolution was sparked by the introduction of the internet to the world. In every domain, it has expanded the application scope, and it is still growing. Throughout history, there were many sources of information, including those not connected to computers. Throughout our whole computing process, we have dealt with this information. Unlike classical computers, quantum computers exhibit certain properties. A quantum device is a device whose operation is governed by quantum physics. In order to implement such advanced communication among quantum devices or computers, a link that can provide the same level of security and allow for such secure communication has to be created. When quantum internet and classical internet are effectively used together, we can achieve unparalleled capabilities with quantum information processing. Our survey paper has discussed more of the technologies that make up quantum internet and its concept.

articleTitle: Smart Waste Segregation System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays waste segregation is one of the difficult tasks to perform. Everyone is looking for an IoT (Internet of Things) based smart solution to achieve this. In this paper, a waste segregation multiple chamber apparatus is proposed with the inclusion of IoT technology. A smart dustbin is proposed in which there are different chambers, the first chamber is designed for the cutter which will cut the waste into smaller pieces after that segregation of the waste or left-over is executed on the basis of bio-degradable or non-biodegradable by making use of the sensors. The bio-degradable waste is then forwarded towards the compost formulation process, whereas non-biodegradable waste is cut into more smaller pieces if required and then shredded into a container. If the container is full, an alarm is generated to take the necessary actions. The proposed system is cost effective and really easy to implement.

articleTitle: Flood Monitoring System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Flood is one of the catastrophic events that cannot be maintained a strategic distance from. It happens very quick and influences such a significant number of lives and properties. Every year, the death rate due to flood increases due to lack of early warning. Majority of the people in general cannot screen, and thus do not know when the flood would occur because they do not have any factual information of the climatic conditions. The proposed system can reduce the few disadvantages of the already created systems. If the general society has a web connection, they would be able to screen what is going on as well as can have an idea whether there is an upcoming flood. The proposed system is less expensive towards design and maintenance.

articleTitle: Smart Education Platform to Enhance Student Learning Experience during COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The community of learners of these days are highly motivated to use the latest trends in education due to the current demand of the education sector. When the Smart education scenario is observed, various advancements in Smart cities play a vital role. Situations like the current pandemic of COVID-19 has forced the entire community of learners to learn through online mode and most of the educational institutions are opting for this mode for a safe learning environment. Several tools are available to support this of which Zoom is one of the most popular online tools and many institutions are using Zoom for online activities related to teaching and learning practice. This paper shows the results of one of such practice implemented during the current situation including the infrastructure of Video Streaming Server utilizing recorded zoom meetings and Moodle. Data is collected by means of a survey conducted among the staff and students. Results have revealed that this practice has shown a good impact on flexibility, accessibility and innovation on learners. The engagement has a scope for improvement to motivate the learners.

articleTitle: PlantGhostNet: An Efficient Novel Convolutional Neural Network Model to Identify Plant Diseases Automatically
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Plants are an integral part of the food chain. They provide food to the majority of the world's population. Besides this, the economy of many countries depends on agriculture directly or indirectly. The productivity of agriculture is directly dependent on the health of crops. Therefore, the identification of diseases in plants during their initial growing phases provides more profit to farmers and improves the economies of many agrarian countries. This paper proposes a novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model named PlantGhostNet for automatic plant disease detection. The proposed PlantGhostNet model reduces the amount of trainable parameters significantly. To decrease the trainable parameters, the Ghost Module is used. This research work also uses Squeeze-and-Excitation Module for performance improvement of the proposed model. To the best of our knowledge, there is no research work present in the literature that utilizes the combination Ghost Module and Squeeze-and-Excitation Module for plant disease detection. The PlantGhostNet model is used to identify the Bacterial Spot disease of peach plants. However, the proposed work can be applied to diagnose other plant diseases as well. The PlantGhostNet model achieves 99.75 percent training accuracy and 99.51 percent validation accuracy in detecting Bacterial Spot disease of peach plants. High accuracy and less amount of trainable parameters make the PlantGhostNet model suitable to be deployed in low computational power devices such as smartphones, tablets, etc.

articleTitle: Path Detection for Self-Driving Carts by using Canny Edge Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A lane detection system is the most principal component of a self-driving transportation computation system. It deals with various complex scenarios such as lane curvature worn out marking, lane changing, turning U-turns, ending and separating lines. Many modern corporations and enterprises like Tesla have been able to achieve second grade i.e., partial automation at a commercial level. In this research paper, an improved and optimized lane detection method is proposed by using the OpenCV's canny edge detection algorithm. A quick and robust method that can easily detect lanes in a live video feed or a pre-recorded video stream. This proposed framework effectively combines the OpenCV's canny edge algorithm with the Hough transform function so it can be applied in small scale applications specifically for visitor carts in an apartment complex. Testing and analysis of the program shows that the suggested software is very reliable.

articleTitle: EMG Classification Using Nature-Inspired Computing and Neural Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Biomedical signals are vital signs that are globally recorded to monitor any alternation in the biological systems. Electromyography (EMG) signal is one of the biomedical signals that record the fluctuations in the electrical signals generated due to neuro-muscular activity. The vital aspects of the presented research focus on various aspects, namely, pre-processing and feature selection, adjoining EMG signal classification, and pattern recognition. The recorded signals first undergo noise reduction followed by the involvement of a Genetic Algorithm as bio-inspired computing to select the viable features and dimensionality reduction of the obtained feature set. This step significantly improved the classification efficacy of the multi-layered neural architecture to distinguish EMG patterns obtained based on neuromuscular activity. The comparative analysis performed using Electro-Myography EMG dataset demonstrated an improved precision and recall with an overall classification accuracy of 95%. Thus, the proposed work offers an automated EMG classification platform with potential applications in the present healthcare informatics system to meet the practical challenge in terms of reliability.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Techniques of Facemask Detection using Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The hasty spread of Coronavirus around the entire world prompted a number of red alerts in various areas including human health, humanity and day to day living styles of human beings. During this pandemic situation, face masks have been used worldwide for protecting humans against the disease of Coronavirus. Face masks are the best and most effective known method to control the dissemination of Covid-19. It is really very difficult to correctly monitor whether the individual have worn face mask or not in order to notify the victim in crowded and hustled places. The face mask detection process generally uses a camera to capture live streaming videos of crowd places and converting them into images. The systems for mask detection are developed with a toll-way gate which allows only if the person crossing it has a face mask worn on his/her face or it does not allow the person in. This paper aims to review various techniques proposed for identifying whether the individuals are wearing facemask or not to protect themselves and others from this deadly virus.

articleTitle: Arduino Sigfox in Smart Trash Can System
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Good waste management has become an important issue for our planet. publicly and natural areas, several don't concentrate to the waste they leave behind. once there's no employee accessible, it's easier to depart waste on website than bring them back. Even the thus referred to as preserved areas are contaminated by waste. To preserve natural areas, it's vital to supply well-managed waste assortment points. The trash cans are installed in isolated areas. The facility is offer by battery, presumably connected to a solar array. Sigfox seems to be a really smart resolution. Sigfox communication system features a wide space coverage. Its permits to deploy the project on an oversized scale. Sigfox system provides enough communication capabilities for our use case. Sigfox will offer a 100m localization resolution. It could be a low power resolution, that permits the device to work an extended time autonomously.

articleTitle: Improved Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) has an evolving technology and is able to be used in critical situation such as commercial applications like traffic surveillance, buildings, smart homes and habitat monitoring, etc. One of the biggest challenges today for wireless sensor networks is security. Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) security models required the following services like integrity and authentication and confidentiality. A well-designed cryptographic algorithm is the secret to developing a riskless WSN scheme in order to fulfil the requirement for sensor nodes with less resource and low power consumption. Public-key cryptography algorithm, namely elliptical curve cryptography (ECC) & elliptic curve digital signature algorithm (ECDSA), have attracted interest from the many researchers in various institutions because of the security and high performance of these algorithms. Algorithms based on the elliptical curve (EC) have proved computationally efficient and provide more security in comparison to traditional crypto-algorithms in the specified key size. ECDSA is first successful ECC- based algorithm. This paper includes descriptions of ECDSA using the SHA-l. We analyse and propose a improve ECDSA algorithm. The main objective of this improved algorithm is to be provide more security as compared to previous algorithm.

articleTitle: Clustering Algorithms in Gene Expression: Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Data Mining is an analytical procedure proposed to have an insight of consistent patterns or logical associations between variables, and further the findings are validated by applying the identified patterns to generate new subcategories of data. With the growing demand for analysing gene expression profiles with high dimensionality, clustering has become competent for splitting up the genes into different groups showing similar patterns with variation in expression level. Numerous techniques have been designed for clustering or categorizing genes to explore the expression data to provide solutions to real world problems. In this paper, we provide general orientation for selecting promising algorithm to cluster microarray data.

articleTitle: Blockchain as an Instrument for Land Ownership and Authorization of Services
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Land disputes in India take on an average about 20 years to be resolved. To make matters worse, land-related disputes account for nearly two-thirds of all pending court cases in India. Disputes related to land ownership affect agriculture as land is used as collateral for obtaining loans by farmers. Such issues also affect development of new infrastructure due to nonavailability of encumbrance free land, demands for higher compensation by landowners, and filing of large number of arbitration cases by landowners. Land related disputes impact urbanisation too given the acute shortage for housing in the country. Last, but not the least generation of black money through benami transactions could be pre-empted and eliminated by digitisation of land records and their regular upgradation. While the problem is humongous, digitization is, perhaps, only the first step in the right direction. The solution needs to ensure that all existing land records are accurate and free of any encumbrances. It also needs to be more all-encompassing to address issues around land ownership, so far has not addressed. Blockchain due to its characteristics of trust and immutable ledger could be the potential solution to address this problem. The paper explains how Blockchain can help improve transparency, trust and efficiency of land ownership data.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection on BraTS 2020 Using U-Net
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Main objective of this framework is to build a efficient deep learning model to detect the brain tumor. In this paper, the framework mainly focuses on the detection of brain tumor MRI images from the BraTS2020 dataset which is a part of the MICCAI BraTS2020 challenge, using U-Net architecture which is suitable for quick and accurate image classification and achieved a training accuracy of 98.485%. When compared to other architectures on BraTs2020 dataset, U-Net architecure with customization provides better results.

articleTitle: Quantitative Data Analysis of Non-Functional Testing in Container Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Container applications development is rapidly being adopted by application developers across domains. This is because of the efficiency and ease of maintenance that comes along with containerized applications. Although exponential acceptance of containerized solution has also brought in the complexity of the overall eco system that plays a bigger part in keeping container-based application production worthy. The learning curve from traditional application development to container-based application is commendable but it also brings the nuances of accepting non-functional characteristics that surrounds the containerized applications. Developers and testers are at receiving end wherein no global standards exist to test the Non-functional part of their application. This writeup tries to delve into the minds of such experts from industry who are at the helm of application development. The data collected as part of this extensive exercise is further analysed to present the broad view of industry and their inclination of the importance of a generic framework to test Non-functional aspect of containerized applications.

articleTitle: Automated Forest Fire Prediction Systems: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Forest fires are one of the greatest risks to wildlife as well the human economy and the cases of wildfires have increased in the previous several years. The main causes are global warming and ongoing human intervention with natural environments. Automated forest fire prediction systems can lessen the harm caused to forests by detecting fire in the early stage and sending alerts to the concerned team so that appropriate preventive measures can be taken timely. In past few years, vast research has been conducted in this field while implementing various methodologies such as classification, clustering, supervised and unsupervised learning and so on. In this paper, the comprehensive review of such techniques is presented which can help users to identify the prediction systems based on its accuracy. This paper also presents a detailed comparative analysis of various existing techniques in terms of accuracy of the prediction systems.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Devanagari Handwriting Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Offline Handwriting Recognition, allows to recognize and convert physical files and images to a digital form. Handwriting recognition is a vast area of research and a lot of contribution has been witnessed in past decades. Devanagari Script is one of the scripts for which many sophisticated handwriting recognition systems are not available. Deep Learning techniques, however, have been able to generate excellent results and enhanced performance. This paper thoroughly examines the recent advancements in deep learning architectures to recognize Devanagari Handwritten characters from varying datasets. The paper has been focused on Devanagari Handwritten Recognition Systems background, challenges, opportunities and future research trends. Several publicly available datasets have also been mentioned along with their data size, type of characters. A comparative study has been done to present the results and insights of the state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Collaborative Cloud Computing using Dedicated Shared Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A collaborative cloud based on Open-Source OpenStack Cloud Framework where different partners will come together and will plug in their dedicated Infrastructure. This contributed Infrastructure from different partners will create a big pool of Infrastructure Resources. All the Infrastructure resource owners will be eligible to receive credits whenever someone else is using their idle resources. And whenever somebody requires more resources than their available dedicated resources can hire the resources available in the pool from other partners. This will increase the usage of Infrastructure which is generally left idle on private clouds. And it will also make it easy for Partners to meet their demands at times whenever they require more resources than their available dedicated resources.

articleTitle: Comparison Parameters of MANET Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: MANET is a group of device hypervisor creating a virtualization layer that does not have any hold or hierarchical operational transportation system. These networks are hyper and actualization because of the flexibility of the devices in the system. Participants serve not just as an informational measure, but also as moderators. Information is to or from other base stations. Mapping systems are designed in MANETs to identify unique directions from origin to target. The ad hoc Data Transmission Method's main objective is to face several complexities of evolving progressively. There must also be an appropriate solution among network cells with optimum impedance connectivity and connectivity usage. According to the flexibility and the compound existence of the protocols, the development of these connectivity procedures is difficult. The parameters for the mapping of MANET occur broken down into: constructive and responsive. This paper highlights the MANET features and obstacles. There will also be a discussion of the above-listed forms of beneficial networking techniques. Notably, in granular form and efficiency parameters, these parameters are also compared and evaluated to get their efficiency scores; DSDV, OLSR, and AODV.

articleTitle: Secure Software Immune Receptors from SQL Injection and Cross Site Scripting Attacks in Content Delivery Network Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In our proposed work the web security has been enhanced using additional security code and an enhanced frame work. Administrator of site is required to specify the security code for particular date and time. On user end user would be capable to login and view authentic code allotted to them during particular time slot. This work would be better in comparison of tradition researches in order to prevent sql injection attack and cross script because proposed work is not just considering the security, it is also focusing on the performance of security system. This system is considering the lot of security dimensions. But in previous system there was focus either on sql injection or cross script. Proposed research is providing versatile security and is available with low time consumption with less probability of unauthentic access.

articleTitle: Internet of Thing based Electrical Device Surveillance and Management Apparatus
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized the way of living. The word “automatic” can be seen come into the practice with the advent of IoT. Humans and interact with devices and devices can interact with humans and also with each other. this has made life exceptionally easy. we are now surrounded by Smart Cities, Smart Devices, Smart Cars, and likewise through the IoT. Along with the advantages, come few limitations as well. The major limitation of interconnecting and establishing communication between the devices is the power consumption. Being part of a developing nation, this limitation becomes all the more challenging. The purpose of discussing the Energy-saving from Electrical Device Scrutiny and Control systems based on the Internet of Things is imperative because a hefty amount of energy is disbursed by lighting appliances, so making enhanced proficiency and hasty fault detection device may be a substantial challenge. To overwhelm this matter, appropriate energy-saving procedures and lighting control are to be executed. In the proposed model, we have two types of models which approaches are tracked counting on the character of application for on-premise ranges with narrowed buildings IEEE 802.11n wireless technology is active where all the appliances are connected with a standard Wi-Fi network. In the other model have related to the street lamp with a hefty number of devices connected only in a single wired way, a wired configuration is hired to avoid range issues.

articleTitle: Pursuit for Authentic News using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Fake news spreads like a wildfire and this is a big issue in this era. The Online world contains lots of fake news from various sources and channels by political parties, influential peoples, and bots. People are not good for easily able to distinguish fake news from real one. This will negatively impact people's lives, society, and the world. To maintain stability from the harm done by fake news, we will tackle the topic of fake news detection. we are investigating the effectiveness of machine learning technologies and also introducing a deep learning model for fake news detection with better accuracy. We are using Natural language processing with the above technologies for our purpose. In investigating the effectiveness of machine learning technologies, we had applied various classification algorithms on our data processed by NLP to obtain their accuracy for the problem. Then using new emerging technologies like deep learning, we are proposing solutions with better accuracy. In the machine learning technologies for fake news detection, we have found that AdaBoost classifier, Gradient boosting classifier, and Logistic regression are better in terms of accuracy than other classifiers like decision tree, KNeighbors classifier, Random Forest classifier, and MultinomialNB. But These technologies are more prone to error when a different category of data comes. Deep learning technology used here is the Long short-term memory deep learning model which gave us an accuracy of more than 0.993 and the Bi-directional LSTM model with accuracy near 0.99 taking more time in training than the LSTM model. Through this research, we conclude that machine learning technologies perform worse than deep learning technologies. And proposed LSTM model is better than the Bi-directional LSTM model for fake news detection.

articleTitle: Electronic Waste Mitigation using Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Solar energy is an infinite source of energy that, if properly harnessed, would make mankind devoid of using the traditional energy sources, which has been used for a long time. Solar energy has come a long way during last decades years. Advances in technology over the next few years will make solar energy much affordable. By 2030, solar will be the most important source of energy for power generation in many countries around the world. It will also have a positive impact on climate change and the environment. Advancements in technology introduced the production of millions of electronics items per day worldwide. These electronics items on completion of their lifecycle add to the electronic waste or e-waste. E-waste is a serious concern for global waste management agencies worldwide as due to their toxicity, neither can it be used in landfills nor left unattended. Various solutions have been explored by the researchers for the mitigation of e-waste. The use of solar charging in electronic systems has shown lots of promise. This paper discusses the impact of e-waste along with technologies to reduce it.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Task Offloading in Mobile Based Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In recent years, the usage of smart phones has increased tremendously. These devices are enough capable to support high number of intensive applications which results shorten power and limited performance. Cloud Computing can augment the computing capabilities of smart mobile phones by computational offloading. In the case of low bandwidth conditions, migration of complex and large data on cloud takes more energy and time than processing data on mobile devices. In this paper, an energy efficient task offloading algorithm is proposed to achieve the energy-efficiency for mobile application in the cloud assisted environment. The proposed offloading algorithm is used to determine what kind of tasks should be chosen to migrate on cloud. The result shows that the proposed algorithm can achieve efficiency upto 93.2 % for execution time and 97.6 % for energy.

articleTitle: Haptic Feedback System for Differently Abled Using Their Inputs
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Haptic advancement is frequently alluded to as deepesestic correspondence or 3D touch; implies any improvement that can make a feeling of touch by utilizing a couple of powers, vibrations, or upgrades to the client. These enhancements can be utilized to make special visualizations for PC age, visual control gadgets, and update hardware and contraptions (telerobotics). Haptic gadgets might join the visual feelings of the work power utilized by the client on the interface. The word haptic, got from the Greek: signifies “property, related with the feeling of touch.” Straightforward haptic contraptions are significant as game controls, fun sticks, and associating wheels

articleTitle: Distribution Management of Drugs/medicines and vaccines vis-a-vis Free Drugs Service Initiative (FDSI) of Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India in the Indian States
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: As they say “Health is wealth”. The saving is even more pertinent in the times of any pandemic like COVID-19, wherein the effect of health infrastructure is evident in almost every phase of life. Every country is trying to improve health service delivery for its citizens. Availability of the right drugs at right time for the right person (patient) is the task easier said than done. In the Indian context, Free Drugs Service Initiative (FDSI) is the Government of India's ambitious program aimed at ensuring the health of its citizens. Among others, Supply chain management or Inventory management of drugs & vaccines is an important aspect to consider for achieving better health of the citizens. This paper provides inputs about the various Inventory Management or Supply Chain Management software that are in use in the various Indian States for the Distribution of Essential Drugs down the hierarchy from Headquarters or State Drug Warehouses to the Patients.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Gamification Tool for Teenagers for Selection of Higher Education Path Based on Personality Traits
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Gamification is used as a powerful way to connect and engage player in an effective and enjoyable funny mood. The current research work demonstrates how gamification is designed and developed in an innovative way to find out different personality traits of the teenagers and recommends the possible career choices available for them based on their personality traits connecting it to the requirements of different professional careers. OCEAN model is used to find out different personalities and gamification concepts like design, elements and storytelling are used to develop gamified system.

articleTitle: Smart Farming and Image Analysis of Agriculture Through Deep Learning Resulting in Land Quality Check
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Machine Learning is the ability provided to machines to improve with experience. In the world, which is preparing itself to get adapted to automated tools in the upcoming future, machine learning defines the core of these dynamic fields such as robotics, various E platforms, etc. & with the extent in vision it has a wider scope. History provides us with the traces that our ancestors discovered the concept of civilization due to agriculture. In the modern world blending the trending automated tools with traditional agricultural practices. India is the largest producer of grains in the world. Being from the land of farmers and farmlands we come across a wide variety of crops that are grown in respective seasons. But sometimes the blessing turns out to be a curse for the farmers. There is a wide variety of challenges farmers face such as climatic disasters, pests, quality of seeds, land quality, etc. and here we are working on using the modern machinery methods to solve these issues and paving the nation towards Jai Jawaan, Jai Kissan, Jai Vigyan. In this present research work, we investigate the Deep learning technology in encompassing traditional farming into Smart farming

articleTitle: Crop Analysis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Food is one of the necessities of a person for endurance. With the population increasing with each day, it gets clear to produce adequate harvests to take care of the increasing numbers. In addition, the economy depends on agriculture too. Yet, there is a critical danger to agriculture production and thus arises the need of automatic identification and analysis of crops.This paper introduces a methodology for building an automatic system which recognizes infection using the leaf pictures and some features like recommending the remedy for that infection. A model has been created using convolution neural network and transfer learning approach using Inception v3 and ResNet 50 .The best-fit model has been chosen to be Inception v3 based on the accuracy of the models. Further this model has been implemented and the data for remedies for the infectious crops has been indicated and added in the model.

articleTitle: Predictive analysis of Covid on economy of India using machine learning technqiue
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Corona Virus (COVID-19) outbreak in December 2019 had a devastating effect on the world. The impact of the coronavirus epidemic has not only affected economic activity but also human life. There is exponential growth in machine learning technique for analyzing the medical data. Therefore, predictive analysis is performed using various algorithm to showcase the impact of Covid on different parameter of economy. This paper aim to assess the overall impact of COVID-19 on the Indian economy through digital learning. Statistical data from reliable sources were collected to determine the impact of Covid on the Indian economy. With this the actual difference between the asper count and the actual number can be determined and can be considered as a reference for future. In this paper, hybrid of L1 regression and tree based algorithm is contributed for optimized feature section process. Further, KNN is utilized for classifying the target values. The different performance metrics are computed on model, thus achieving accuracy of 98%, precision as 81.5%, Recall as 99% and F1-score as 92.5% respectively.

articleTitle: Data Storage Encryption With Passphrase Using Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Security of the data is the utmost important in today's world scenario. To achieve completeprivacy of the data stored on various electronic devices like laptops, computers, external hard disk, USB drives etc. data storage encryption is needed to make the data more secure for any organization or any small offices. Encrypting the data provides a way out for the organization to keep a firm hold on their sensitive data or information. Intelligent devices like laptops and PC's are prone to security attacks resulting in the compromising the data. This problem can be solved by employing data encryption. Thought many encryption techniques are being used to make the data secure but a hybrid encryption algorithm should be used to make the data encryption more secure.

articleTitle: Process Automation techniques in Hospitality Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today's scenario, the evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI), most of the services provided by industries and organizations are digital. Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and workflow automation has several benefits in automating the existing business processes. It improves the accuracy, efficiency, productivity and overall customer satisfaction for a business process. In this manuscript, a study of existing approaches to automate the business process for customer relationship management have been discussed. Furthermore, some tools used for workflow automation have been also discussed for improvement of efficiency and productivity of existing business processes.

articleTitle: Greeting Image Remover
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The continuous development of information technology along with the communication devices like mobiles and tablets which are available for daily use have increased many folds in the recent year. A variety of companies are providing these devices with different specifications. A lot of these specifications roam around the storage available in these devices. The continuous development in these devices and applications has potentially increased the need for having sufficient storage capacity. Communication applications like WhatsApp, Hike, Signal, Telegram, etc. are used worldwide to stay connected. Almost all of the phone users use these apps to communicate with their close people or for business purposes. These chat apps have become an ingrained part of daily life of the phone users these days. These social communication apps allow the phone users to receive several media files. One such media file which is frequently used is images. Images of greetings like ‘Good Morning’, ‘Good Night’ or wishes for the festivals like ‘Happy Diwali”, ‘Merry Christmas' fill up the storage of the user's devices. These images have emotions attached to them from the sender, but it is actually just simply eating up space in the devices. Day by day these images fill up a sizable amount of space which leads to actually going back and deleting them in bulk manually to free up space. The objective of this project is to assist the user out instead of manually deleting these greetings to automate this process. The application is designed so that it searches these greeting images and gives the user the option to delete them or not. The automated process of searching the images saves the user time and effort and it helps in recovering the storage which can be used by the device.

articleTitle: Web mapping spatial data information analysis using the Free Open Source Software Server Service (FOSSSS)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Free Open Source Software server Service (FOSSSS) is computer software that anyone can use, modify, and distribute without restriction. Many people or organizations contribute to open source software, which is provided under licenses that follow the Open Source Definition. This study to represent the how to manipulate and visualization of map based application using open source server like GeoServer. This study also interacts with web solution of GIS applications using different Free Open Source Software server (FOSSS) solutions. Low cost, great stability and security are all benefits of open server software, which handling mini and medium sized web based GIS application projects prefer it as a result. An efficient WebGIS system is presented in this research. The area of GIS has grown at a rapid pace in recent decades, and it now includes both proprietary and open source GIS software. After introducing the essential principles of WebGIS, it chose open-source technologies such as Apache Tomcat, GeoServer, and PostGIS. Finally, discussion on how to integrated web based GIS small application.

articleTitle: A Review on Generative Adversarial Networks used for Image Reconstruction in Medical imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In computer vision, Because of its capacity to generate data, generative adversarial networks have gotten much interest. Generative Adversarial Network (GANs) opens different ways to overcome difficulties in medical image investigations like de-noising of the captured image, reconstruction of captured medical image, segmentation of the captured medical image, synthesis of the captured image, detection and classification of processed medical image. GANs great potentials in image restoration or reconstruction for different anatomy open a new research area. However, image reconstruction for specific anatomy is still facing the challenge. This article consists of a recent literature review on the applications of GAN for the reconstruction of medical images. Different reconstruction methods in the field of medical imaging were explored in this paper thoroughly. We have studied the foremost relevant publications.

articleTitle: Big Data Analytics: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the current era of digitization, data is the key and base of each business, system, and framework. Data is being generated every nanosecond. Data collected from various systems and business frameworks like medical, retail, stocks, social media platforms etc. is completely large and raw. This raw data is of no use to make any intelligent system, meaningful derivation, logical assessment, or application. Data analysis plays an important role in this process of converting raw data to useful data. The process of data analytics pre-processes the raw date and converts it to useful data to extract meaningful information and knowledge. During the process of data analysis, enormous amount of data is extracted and analysed using various well-defined approaches. Furthermore, decision makers need to be able to gain valuable insights from such varied and rapidly changing data, ranging from daily transactions to customer interactions and social network data. Hence, data analytics can provide such value in almost all industries. This paper discusses the basic concepts of Big Data Analysis, its sequential stages, applications in different domains and challenges that are being faced by it. As Big Data is related to data mining, this work also includes mining tools & algorithms being used for data extraction.

articleTitle: Reliability Aware Mechanism to ensure increased Fault Tolerance using Throttle Load Balancer
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Virtual Machines are created to provide sharable resources to the physical machines with limited resources with the help of Cloud Computing. With the advancement in the technology, the cloud users are increasing rapidly. Even though Cloud resources are infinite but they are not enough to fulfill the increasing demands of the users. This paper proposed the mechanism of handling multiple requests from multiple users to the cloud. It has two parts: in the first part all the VM's are monitored and the optimal VM with sufficient resources to handle the requests is selected and in the second part the tasks are allocated the required resources. It also checks the load on each virtual machine by continuous monitoring and if the load is increased, migration is done to the next VM using the phenomenon of Throttle Load Balancer. This complete system handles the faults even before it is occurred, so it falls under the proactive fault tolerance. The simulation is conducted within Netbeans IDE and Cloudsim 4.0 and evaluation parameters are load balancing degree, throughput and execution cost.

articleTitle: Design of Trade Promotion to Maximize Overall Supply Chain Profitability using Mathematical Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Manufacturers offer Trade Promotions to retailers with the objective of making their products more accessible to end consumers or reducing the inventory level. There are two broad types of trade promotions - off-invoice and scan-back. Retailers prefer off-invoice promotions, but this often leads to lesser profit for manufacturers because of the forward buying from retailers in the promotion period. Manufacturers prefer scan-back-based promotions. But retailers are not attracted to the simple Scan-back deals due to the risk involved in selling the product to the end consumer in the stipulated promotion period. The proposed model designs a promotional strategy that is acceptable to both parties - manufacturer and retailer. The promotion strategy is designed in such a way that it maximizes the manufacturer's profit while ensuring that the retailer's profit is greater than or equal to the retailer's profit in an off-invoice case. Two approaches are tried out to check the overall profitability of the supply chain: without Inventory cost and with Inventory cost. The system uses the log-log regression model to assess the impact of the product's price and its corresponding demand, thereby providing the price elasticity value, which is one of the essential input parameters. The optimization model is a constrained nonlinear optimization model.

articleTitle: Solving Differential Equations using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Neural Networks (NNs) in recent years have evolved as a framework to solve various complex mathematical equations. NN has numerous real life applications in almost every field like medicines, biometrics, automation industry, pharmaceutical etc. This has prompted mathematicians to explore NN technique to get the approximate solutions of many physical problems for which analytical solutions may not exist. In mathematical modelling, differential equations play a crucial role for solving the physical problems. In this paper, application of NN as universal solvers for Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) and Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) has been explained. The Neural Network is developed for initial and boundary value problems of different order ODEs and PDEs. The main objective here is to develop the single neural network for solving these equations. This is achieved by applying back-propagation learning algorithm with single layer and logistic sigmoid function. The results are tested for different number of neurons and various losses are generated to get the best loss corresponding to the output. The results show high degree of accuracy between the true solution and the approximate solution as much as the resulting error reaches 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup> for ODEs and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> for PDE. Further, the results exhibit that the same strategy developed here can be applied to solve any order PDEs and ODEs.

articleTitle: An Improved Anisotropic Diffusion Filtering Approach for noise reduction in MRI
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A confined, non-invasive and accurate diagnosis procedure is preferred for investigation of numerous human body disorders. Magnetic Resonance (MR) Imaging is one such crucial and popular diagnostic procedure and therefore these MR images need to be noise free to reduce the chances of error in diagnosis. An improved and novel approach has been suggested to denoise MR images by utilizing unbiased non local means (UNLM) method and anisotropic diffusion method. The proposed method's performance has been compared with other denoising techniques and the results were evaluated on metrices like Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Mean Square Error (MSE) and Structure Similarity Index (SSIM) values. The proposed method produced successful results and the process of anisotropic diffusion was hence improved. The MR images were well denoised and fine structures were also preserved along with the edges.

Author Keywords: Anisotropic Diffusion Unbiased Non local means

articleTitle: Movie Success Prediction Using Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The entertainment industry is a rapidly growing billion-dollar industry. With new milestones being reached almost every day, this industry has proved itself to be a very profitable business, if done correctly. Since huge investments are involved in the production and making of movies, both in terms of time and money, it would only make sense to try to predict the outcome beforehand. In an attempt to tackle this problem, we have built a model that predicts whether or not a movie can be called a success. The model compares the performance of three machine learning algorithms i.e. Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, and Support Vector Machine (SVM), over two different datasets, to observe which performs better. We have illustrated the model, as well as its results, findings, and observations in this literature.

articleTitle: Compact Cross Elliptical Patch Antenna with Wideband Characteristics for IOT Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this article we have proposes a compact size antenna for UWB and RADAR applications. It consists of a cross elliptical radiating patch connected to the microstrip line that feed to it and a rectangular ground plane on the other side of the FR_4 epoxy dielectric substrate(∊<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>=4.4). The size of the antenna is small having dimensions 20×28×1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Additional to this for reducing the interference from the IEEE WiMAX band from 3.0 to 3.4 GHz an inverted T filter has been stubbed to the radiating patch by etching a square slot into it. The antenna has losses less than −10dB and positive gain in the desired operating regions for UWB and RADAR application till 12GHz. The antenna is designed and results are simulated on the HFSS software.

articleTitle: Hybrid Load Scheduling in Content Delivery Network Comprising of Under Populated Clusters
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Serving content to the worldwide distributed clients with high availability, high efficiency and minimum delay is the primary challenge for today's virtual world. Content delivery network (CDN) was evolved with the aim to send the data at the client's doorstep with almost zero latency. CDN disseminates the content at various edge servers deployed to the client's close proximity. But locating the positions for deployment and also sharing the load among the servers are two major concerns for CDN. In this paper, unsupervised K-means clustering is considered for selecting the locations for server deployment which also considers the under populated clusters based on a parameter called population threshold. This paper introduces a hybrid load sharing model which is mainly concerned about the traffic coming from the clusters with population lesser than the threshold. The result of the study shows that this hybrid approach enhances the server utilization factors of the surrogates deployed in the network while minimizes the server maintenance and cost overhead.

articleTitle: iChat: Interactive Eyes for Specially Challenged People Using OpenCV Python
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Dream of a world with no complaints or demands, just peace and happiness of every individual doesn't seem so far now. Interaction of eyes with computers is a rising and much awaited innovation which alludes to countless calculations, algorithms, strategies that help in maintaining and improving the process. Recalling the era of Stephen hawking and seeking reference from the work of Dennis Klatt, Eye Gaze development in that context is the most encouraging innovation known up until now and in this paper utilizing the assistance of Kivy in python, we have the ideal philosophy to make the world one stride nearer to a smart digital world. We utilize the 68 facial points dataset which must be present in every face specifically eye, nose, jaw, etc. Precision is what we seek for in this work and in order to achieve that we keep our face still which makes eye detection from camera easier and accuracy certainly increases. Further, the division of the Virtual keyboard made using python dictionaries into left and right makes it more convenient to choose by an eye blink as one can first select the section of the keyboard which consists of the key/alphabet required to be printed. We use Pyglet module for including sound in our project. Further, Integration of our project with a platform like Kivy makes it a miracle app for differently abled. Kivy, an open-source platform, includes detection of eye blinking, right from the webcam/mobile camera using OpenCV library in python along with tracking (left or right) of the eyes to left or right. Our main aim is a typing and chatting environment without the use of hands, fingers which is a blessing for those born specially challenged or have lost the physical ability or have paralysis. An app that has never happened before will change the lives of millions seeking help. The methodology includes descriptive flowcharts in each phase followed by the expected and implemented results.

articleTitle: Simulation Annealing Based Approach to Enhanced Load Balancing in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today's environment as demand of users to access services or data and manage that data in easily manner is challenging issue so that to overcome this problem cloud computing is widely used. CC provides various services and space to store data to the users. Due to heavy load on cloud as number of similar requests received a cloud in seconds is very challenging task. To handle dynamic load is very challenging for cloud servers. To overcome this problem in this paper we propose a Simulation Annealing SA based approach to dynamically distribute loads to the cloud so that throughput may increases.

articleTitle: Printed Microstrip Patch Antenna with Truncated comers for Quad-band Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A multi-band microstrip patch antenna with truncated corners for various wireless applications has been proposed in this paper. The antenna consists of a rectangular patch having dimensions of (29.8*38.4*0.03mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>). The patch is mounted on FR-4 material, which is used as the dielectric substrate. Multiple bands are obtained covering frequencies from 2.4-2.5GHz, 2.9-3.0GHz, 4.3-4.4GHz, and 4.5-4.7GHz supporting various microwave applications. The first resonant band is used for the IEEE802.11(WLAN-Wi-Fi), IEEE 802.15.4 (LR-WPANs) standards in the SM band. The second frequency band is used to operate unlicensed Part 15 Devices in the AM and FM radio broadcast bands. The third resonant band is used for radio altimeters, satellite, and cordless telephones. The fourth resonant band is helpful for military applications and fixed satellites. The antenna design and simulation are done using CST microwave studio. The simulated parameters such as S-parameters, VSWR, radiation pattern, etc., are observed for the proposed structure. The simulation and the measured results are obtained and compared and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Review of Secured, Robust and Imperceptible Digital Watermarking Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the last two decades, there is an incredible evolution in network and multimedia technology. This advancement also makes easier for unauthorized users to replicate, retransmission, changing reproduction and upload the contents in an illegal way. The increased and widespread usage of digital images has aroused great concerns from malicious attackers. The technology of Digital watermarking provides the methods to overcome the mentioned issues. Therefore, the proposed paper delivers in-depth information about image watermarking. This review paper covers literature review on digital image watermarking covered from various papers. In addition to reviewing many International, National journals, articles and many conferences papers are also taken in this review paper. This paper deals with entire digital image watermarking process from the scratch as the definition of digital image watermarking, their types, characteristics, robustness parameters and the associated literature. The comparative analysis extracts the drawback, deficiencies and limitations of the digital image watermarking process by extracting the research gaps. The ultimate aim of the proposed review is to find the still existing challenges by providing an environment for researchers to tell them a lot more work required in this field. The challenges are categories based on various attacks operators, quality of watermarked image, watermark capacity, false detection rate and security aspects of watermark and watermark process.

articleTitle: Use of Clustering with CNN to Categorize Images inside different directories on OS
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this burgeoning area of Machine Learning and computer vision (CV), image classification plays an eminent role in various real-world problem statements. Advanced implementation of the technology can be used to minimize human interaction with the computers and perform efficiently to overcome the time constraints of the real-world problem. One such application can be used to classify the images stored inside different directories in the operating system and group them on different folders based on their categories. The proposed work focuses on the implementation of this application to overcome the time constraints while searching the images manually inside different directories by the human-computer interaction. This paper demonstrates the use of Keras and Tensorflow to implement CNN on image-based clustering. The convolution operation is used to extract the features from the images. These features are extracted using edge detection, object extraction, and image segmentation. After the features being extracted, the images are clustered (based on their Euclidean distance from other images depending on their features) using the K-means clustering algorithm. To enhance the result, pre-processing is employed on the images for the reduction of noise and elucidate the blurred pixels of the image.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Using Soft Computing Techniques in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, a wide literature review of soft computing techniques in intrusion detection in V ANETs is carried out. The soft computing techniques used by different researchers for carrying out intrusion detection in vehicular networks are examined thoroughly. Summary of different approaches used in intrusion detection are thoroughly discussed. The study will focus on the techniques implemented by researchers in literature for developing the intrusion detection framework using soft computing approaches including, deep learning methods, artificial neural networks, fuzzy logic, and other machine learning methods. The paper also provides the performance analysis as well as the limitations for the reviewed works.

articleTitle: Email Ingestion Using Robotic Process Automation for Online Travel Agency
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Robotic Process Automation is blooming technology. RPA is a low code platform that is used to automate the software task. RPA is being used to automate the frontend and backend of business processes to increase the efficiency and reduce the manpower. The RPA is mainly used for copy, paste, moving and scrapping data from various sources such as websites, app, email and excel sheets. The RPA is considered the most efficient technology for performing the repetitive tasks. In this research we have proposed a design for extracting the data from the email and storing the data automatically using RPA.

articleTitle: Analyzing Trend Probability and Risk Estimation of Rainfall Pattern over Maharashtra
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In meteorology, the prediction and risk analysis of rainfall is one of the foremost concerns. Early prediction of weather has acquired consideration by numerous scientists from different exploration networks because of its impact to the worldwide human existence. The arising profound learning strategies somewhat recently combined with the wide accessibility of huge climate perception information and the approach of data and computer technology innovation have inspired numerous researchers to investigate hidden hierarchical patterns in the enormous volume of climate dataset for climate determining. Several work and many techniques have already been carried out and proposed to predict rainfall. The focus is especially on statistical analysis, machine learning and deep learning techniques to analyze the data and forecast. The study explores profound learning strategies for climate determining. Specifically, proposed the expectation execution of LSTM and ANN models with respect to rain fall prediction. Those models are tried utilizing climate dataset. Forecasting precision of each model is assessed. The consequence of this study expected to add to climate gauging for wide application spaces including flight route to horticulture, the travel industry and early predication of rainfall.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of PLC based Intelligent Traffic Light Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), one of the old and powerful technologies useful in all kinds of industrial processes for controlling, monitoring, automating, and performing the tasks. PLC's are the industrial computers that takes the inputs from the surrounding environments and produces the outputs based on the programs that runs the PLC. PLC is mainly composed of Sensors, Controllers, and Actuators. Then what makes the PLC so different, and unique? The answers lies with its processing capabilities. As the name implies Programmable, Logic, and Controllers. These three terms makes the PLC unique and different from other processors and controllers. In today's world, almost in all the industrial processes, PLC's are used for mainly controlling purposes. There are enormous benefits in it, processing capabilities in it, can process high level applications, used in almost all industries for variety of applications and needs. One application which I consider for my project is intelligent traffic light. The term intelligent makes us to think why it is called so. The reason is intelligent is the one who can tackle with the tasks, control the tasks, monitor the tasks, and self-configure the tasks. In my work, I am going to use PLC to make the traffic light with more intelligence capabilities. PLC forms the central core of my system. In my work, I will be using three different types of modes such as intelligent working mode, routine working mode, and night working mode. Traffic detection and clock controls are given as inputs to the PLC controller. The outputs are the two displays that are traffic light and countdown displays. The project is implemented using CodeSys simulation software where I will show the simulation results. The performance of my intelligent traffic light based on PLC is compared with the traditional PLC system.

articleTitle: Analyzing Psychological Gamers Profile through Progressive Gaming and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Game development has evolved to a point of being a method where it is being used to improve the day-to-day lifestyle of the person playing the game (henceforth referred to as a ‘player’). With these advancements, this paper represents the Integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Game Development. AI has already been introduced in Game Development, ranging from Computer Generated Non-Player Characters (NPC), randomly generated maps or level, or even the difficulty of the level. In Gaming, AI is based on responsive and adaptive video game experiences. Using NPC to power interactive experience to simulate a human Game-player. One of the new Frontier of development and the method games are played, AI uses the behaviour of the player to control the game experience. Games refer to data that is made systematic using algorithms and helps to develop games with human interaction. As a developer, the experience needs to be delivered and AI makes the process easier. AI needs to store information to be able to reference which can respond to various stimuli. The mass of information required is the reason why AI has not been adapted into the Industry. Using Voice Intelligence is changing the inputs of games, and assist to increase intelligence genre games. Creating frameworks using design acknowledgment and reinforcement realizing is an important part of the future of Game development. By making the AI intelligent makes the games more real. Since Players pay attention to details, developers can use AI to help develop the game. In this paper, we will be focusing on the ways to identify the behaviour of the player and then using the information to develop the game further. By creating a profile, we can arrange and suit various reinforcements. Using the 16 personality tests, we can identify and rate the player based on the factor of their Mind, Energy, Nature, Tactics, and Identity.

articleTitle: Attendance System Implementation Using Real Time Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, we propose Facial Recognition using Supervised Learning technique to implement an attendance system using a comparative study between different methods of face detection and face recognition. The first step that is required is face detection, i.e., detecting faces in an image, video or real time coverage consisting of different types of objects (distinguishing faces from non-faces). Once the face is detected, feature extraction, i.e., determining the uniqueness of the face by takin out the features is performed. Eventually, training and classification of the facial databases is done and is tested using various classification techniques based on the comparative performance and efficiency for recognizing faces. We attempt to use this facial recognition system on a data set of faces of institute/university students for which the attendance system will be implemented. Attentiveness Monitoring feature is added which monitors facial features such as eye blinks, yawn and eye movements, to determine the relative attentiveness among students. Consolidated attendance is easily available to view and download.

articleTitle: Teen-alyse: A Mobile Application for Parental control, Teen Self-Monitoring and Active Mediation
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The unprecedented COVID scenario has exponentially increased the exposure of internet to adolescent age group of the world population. The sudden extended online presence of this age group has created an area of concern in parenting fraternity as this is accompanied by restrictions on the normal social life of children. However, study states that direct parental control methods lessen the trust and the bond between the parent and the teen. If the teens are explained about the possible consequences of their online actions in a friendly manner, it helps them to understand the need of self-regulation and caution when they are being part of online community actively or passively. In this work, a self- regulation model is proposed. The self-regulation model is developed as a Mobile app called “Teen-alyse”. This app is designed to help in achieving a balance in parental guidelines and teen self-regulation. Further, the idea of active mediation has been included which encourages both, parent, and teen to have conversation for the time limit set for the mobile apps. By applying an analysis algorithm, the teen's YouTube activities are classified as flagged and not flagged contents and a report is generated, which alerts teens as well as parents. The work proposes the model of teen self-regulating app by following values of parental control, teen self-monitoring and active mediation.

articleTitle: Fostering Analysis of Livelihood Pre and Post Covid-19 using ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The energy sector is one of the major disrupted industries during the time of the lockdowns in all countries. This is causing an irregularity in supply and demand creating various challenges to the sector. The paper provides a comprehensive view on the factors affecting the power usage by the households and the change in trends of consumption of electricity. The paper also included the mental health of the people before and after the COVID lockdown. Two models were created, linear regression for power consumption and logistical regression for mental health. They were verified using various techniques. The purpose of these models is to help researchers and enthusiasts get a better idea about the relationship between various factors which are affecting the power consumption and mental health during the lockdown. They can also be used to predict the outcome if incase any similar event occurs in future.

articleTitle: A Review of Trash Collecting and Cleaning Robots
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Trash present at different locations, both outdoor and indoor is a menace. Collection of the garbage so that it can be disposed off properly can be a mundane and time-consuming job requiring human labor. This was avoided by using Robots to automate this task and increase efficiency. Technologies involved in the development of these automated systems using sensors and processing units such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi. Most of them were built more specific to their requirements like which terrain (indoor or outdoor, land or water) they must work on, and different autonomy levels (manual, remote-control or fully autonomous were attained or proposed to attain successfully by using IoT for remote-control and path-planning using image-processing in fully autonomous robots.

articleTitle: Solar Power based Hybrid Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays the ability to uplift own work is a major concern for the physically disabled people. This makes them not to depend on other and let them to carry their own water. This automated solar powered wheelchair with the accessibility to ease of access to the surrounding with the help of the smart screen packed with the scanner into the hybrid mode of this wheelchair helps to go anywhere without asking anyone and get dependent on others. Also, this wheelchair has the automatic stabilization to the balance of the user sitting on the wheelchair while using it. The inbuilt operations along with the hardware of the smart screen being implanted next to the alternate handle of the user helps them to navigate whereas on the other side there will be the rotating ball for the steering of the wheelchair. The speed also be controlled with the help of the screen as well just with a click. The patent for the proposed wheelchair has been published from Patent office of India, Application number 202011035447, 17th Aug 2020.

articleTitle: INTELLI Parking System using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A metropolis is said smart when diverse areas like homes, health care, irrigation, parking system are fully automated.
