Among these areas, Parking System plays a pivotal role because inefficient parking results in serious problems. Driving around for a parking spot after arriving at a mall or a multiplex is nerve-wracking. An effective and efficient solution to this is a Smart Parking System designed using IoT and Cloud storage. This design supersedes the routine concept of parking system by exploiting IoT technology and combining it with the latest developments such as IR sensors, Ultrasonic sensors, and microcontrollers that collects information about the availability status of parking spaces of different areas. Hence drivers can search for the nearest available parking slot with the help of a customized software application and web page. The main motto behind this idea is to reduce the time taken to search for the parking area. This paper presents novel ideas like sending the average occupancy data to the respective owner to decide on expanding the parking area, detecting the vehicles parked at No Parking Zones. This paper also includes a prototype designed and implemented in real-time.

articleTitle: The Role of higher education and Information Communication Technology in the development of students' personalities and quality education at private university: A Quantitative Exploration
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The subjective purpose of the study was to identify the role of teachers in the personality development of students enrolled in Higher educational institutions in the North Indian region. In education, ICT plays an important role in facilitating teaching and learning. ICT makes the classroom more interactive and collaborative. In the covid 19 pandemic situation, ICT use in Educational institutions is important for giving students opportunities to learn and apply the required skills. Quality education is important to develop students' quality, characteristic, attitude, behaviors, quirks, beliefs and psychological traits which makes up their identity. The sample group of research consist of 1267 students (boys 896, girls 371) from different departments of private university and some other institutions of the North Indian region. A self-developed questionnaire was used where the students were asked to give samples of their university/institution teachers roles, attitude, behavior, knowledge, and skills to know the effects on their personality development and performances.

articleTitle: Detection and Diagnosis of Hepatitis Virus Infection Based on Human Blood Smear Data in Machine Learning Segmentation Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This work aims to choose the right method for hepatitis diagnosis and prevention and hepatitis treatment. Life expectancy estimation in Hepatitis patients seems to be very low. A comparative in this assignment analysis of different machine learning instruments., and they tried out neural networks. The metric's achievement is based on the accuracy rate and an error in the average rectangle. The Machine Learning Algorithms (ML)., such as K Nearest Neighbor (K-NEAREST NEIGHBOR)., Naive Bayes Algorithm and Support Vector Machines (SVM)., were considered classification and prediction tools for Data Segmentation for Detection and diagnosing Hepatitis disease. On the above algorithms, a short study was performed. Focusing on the predictive precision of disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Fair and Efficient Rate Allocation Based Congestion Control Protocol in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nature of wireless sensor networks is such that, when an event occurs, the load on the network increases unexpectedly which results in congestion on the sensor nodes which are unable to process the data generated quickly. In the paper, we have proposed a novel algorithm which will adaptively provide a fair and efficient rate to each flow in the network by allocating approximately fair bandwidth. In the proposed work, we have used available bandwidth resources, and active flows belonging to a particular node to estimate the fair rate that can be efficiently assigned to each node in the network. We suggest a new congestion regulator scheme that attains a roughly equal bandwidth distribution to all the nodes in the network. Intuitively, we expect each flow to obtain a proportionate segment of the existing bandwidth based on its generating rate. The proposed algorithm have been evaluated in the event of congestion on throughput, packet delivery ratio and energy efficiency and it has been proved from simulation that the proposed work achieved better performance.

articleTitle: Efficient Feature Selection Method for Histopathological Images Using Modified Golden Eagle Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Automated medical analysis is growing rapidly for advanced clinical treatment and intervention in diagnosis of patients. Exploration and visualization in the field of histopathology examination are enhancing the decision-making process of pathologists. In this paper, a modified golden eagle optimization technique is proposed for selecting the best subset of features from histopathological images which improve the classification of different categories of histology images. The mean and the best optimal values of the proposed modified golden eagle optimization algorithm is tested on benchmark functions (CEC 2017) namely GEO, WOA, APSO, CSO and LOA. Moreover, the comparative analysis is performed against the recent state of the art algorithm. Furthermore, the experiment results validate that the proposed method outperforms the other considered methods. The accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, recall and F1 score are evaluated for each category of histopathological images using a support vector machine and artificial neural network.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis in High Utility Pattern Mining Using List Based HUPM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: HUPM has been researched successfully in the field of processing data. Traditional Pattern Mining cannot think fully of the features of the databases that have been used in the real world. In contrast, in many applications industries and interaction with details on internet services, the database sizes are increasingly closer to retail sales data by a little bit. This is a general approach that is not adequate for static databases to prepare complex datasets and retrieve useful data. Most incremental utility pattern mining strategies have been developed. It has been proposed that previous methodologies, independent of the use of any framework, require more scanning for incremental utility sequence mining. Guy. In either case, there are proposed for different scans. It's just not enough for stream conditions. We have suggested and Effective algorithm that uses mine High utility trends based list data structure to involving just one search of the database and interested user restrictions limit the space search. This is the Transactional Retail Algorithm uses the database. We add conditions to our method's efficiency, such as duration, object date that helps make forecasts more precise.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Clustering of COVID-19 Symptoms
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) is an infectious respiratory illness caused by Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome CoronaVirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). The virus is new and has caused an unprecedented pandemic that has led into unforeseeable circumstances. Due to lack of knowledge, medical fraternity is facing a lot of hurdles in the detection and treatment of this disease which is caused by coronavirus. It is immensely crucial to handle the prevailing situation for the sake of healthier lives in future. In present scenario, data recorded from the occurrences of the disease worldwide can play a vital role in creating a better understanding of its nature. Based on data, artificial intelligence techniques like machine learning provide useful insights and solutions for real world problems that are otherwise incomprehensible for human. Specifically, clustering is an unsupervised machine learning technique that uses unlabelled data to identify different behaviour, groups and categories of observations. This paper presents a machine learning based clustering approach to identify different clusters of symptomatic profiles of patients suffering from covid-19. Dividing the set of medical symptoms experienced by covid-19 patients into distinct clusters will facilitate an understanding of the different kinds of effects this disease has on human beings. It will also enable development of suitable and effective treatments.

articleTitle: Compression using Matrix Folding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Space optimization is a particular phenomenon which has puzzled the computer programmers worldwide. More and more data needs to be stored into ever decreasing space. Several techniques are utilized to either decompress the files or better manage the memory. The first aspect involves the mathematics behind the conversion and the second aspect involves physics to store more data on to smaller chips. The proposed formulation i.e. The Matrix Folding Algorithm serves the first aspect of Space optimization by making use of mathematical calculations to reduce the size of a matrix. Matrix Folding Algorithm is a technique to reduce the space occupied by a square matrix to a level of 25% of the original size. The algorithm is based on mathematical calculations applied on the original values in order to double fold the matrix first from right to left and then from bottom to top. Like many other algorithms this one also has limitations that the original matrix should have numbers ranging from 0 through 15 only when we consider a system where the integer takes 2 bytes of space. And the matrix should have numbers ranging from 0 through 255 only when we consider a system where the integer takes 4 bytes of space.

articleTitle: Swarm Inspired Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm for Clustered Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays, informational broadcasting is critical for establishing a link between a source and a destination node. Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) have created efficient connectivity because they are a constantly self-configuring, infra-structure-less mobile ecosystem. Due to smaller infrastructures and minimal networks, each customer communicates directly with a base station to obtain valuable information. In WSN, the information transmission is one of the important operations that transmits identical packet to the entire node in the network. During the information broadcasting process, all the neighbouring nodes are capable of forwarding the packets in the community. Based on this transmission the useful information's are forwarding in the network to establish the efficient communication system. Thus, the information broadcasting plays an important vital part in different applications like military, training establishments, crisis administrations, business applications, home and endeavour. Even though the network has several features, the network needs to face various difficulties such as energy consumption, quality of the services; network coverage that reduces the efficiency of the communication process. Therefore, the information transaction is managed by different clustering based routing protocol that reduces the intermediate attacks also maintains the quality of information. We examined the operation of many cluster-based routing protocols and suggested a novel swarm-inspired algorithm for cluster-based wireless sensor networks in this research paper.

articleTitle: Attendance Marking System using Periocular Recognition with Temperature Monitoring (ASPR)
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Of late the COVID pandemic has necessitated authorities to make sure that every candidates are being worn mask. So, this forces to quit from conventional attendance marking systems which only relies on face recognition for biometric identification that involves close proximity or body contact. Wearing of masks can definitely occlude a major area of face. So the proposed project aims at using periocular recognition for biometric identification. The system proposed uses a pre-trained Convolution Neural Network (CNN) model that is VGG16 trained on ImageNet dataset to achieve the target of periocular recognition. Here it involves only a smaller region of interest and so external factors cause only less constraints to periocular recognition. Mask detection, which is an image classification phase, is done with MobileNet V2. This includes training which serialises face mask detectors to disk and deployment which outputs images as ‘with mask’ or ‘without mask’ [1] [2]. Non-contact IR sensor, MLX90614 IR sensor will automatically detect body temperature to determine whether the candidate's temperature is exceeding a threshold value.

articleTitle: Use of AES Algorithm in development of SMS Application on Android Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Encrypting the data when it comes to security from foreign intrusions is necessary. Being such a vast field the search for the perfect algorithm is crucial. Such an algorithm which is feasible, scalable and most importantly not easy to crack is the ideal algorithm for its use, in the application “CRYPTOSMS”.SMS (Short messaging service) is not encrypted end to end like WhatsApp. So, to solve the problem of security, CRYPTOSMS was created so that all the messages sent and received are secured. This paper includes the search for the ideal algorithm for the application by comparison with other algorithms and how it is used in making of the application.

articleTitle: Detection of Pneumonia using Chest X-Ray Images and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Pneumonia is an extremely severe contagion that causes inflammation in the air sacs of one or both lungs. The air pouches may be occupied with liquefied or pus which causes coughing with pus or phlegm, along with fever, chills, and exertion in breathing. Pneumonia may be because of a variety of reasons such as organisms ranging from bacteria to viruses to fungi. Pneumonia can affect us with varying intensity in seriousness ranging from minor to life-threatening. It is seen to be the most serious in toddlers and youngsters, humans older than the age of 65 alongside human beings with health problems or weak immune systems. Due to the severity of this disease, we are doing predictive detection scrutiny using x-ray images. This paper provides a walk-through of the method that we used for the prediction analysis of the data used using Machine Learning algorithms to design the model that we used is: Convolutional Neural Network on the same dataset. Additionally, we have discussed the Confusion Matrix, which predicts the accuracy of the designed models.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique to Detect the Hotspots in Swine Flu Effected Regions
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In present days, healthcare is very essential in human life. The flu (Influenza) tends to spread very rapidly. Influenza is an infectious disease caused by an influenza virus. This is a worldwide infection and causes local or widespread epidemics and pandemics. The most global all over the world spreading virus, known as Swine flu. The Influenza A (H1N1) flu is triggered by means if anyone of several types of swine influenza viruses. So, firstly we have planned to identify who are vulnerable to be effected by the virus and how many patients have died due to swine flu. Since there is a great need to find the hotspots in swine flu affected regions, I was motivated to do research for the identification of hotspots effected more by swine flu. Our exploration centers around this apart of Medical conclusion through studying design through the accumulated records for Swine Flu. Machine learning place key role to identify influenza effected zones, detecting Hotspots and Prioritization Hotspots.

articleTitle: Gaussian Filtering based Image Integration for Improved Disease Diagnosis and Treatment Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Medical images often face degradation caused by noise within an imaging phase. Noise may compromise the standard of medical imaging. As an additional note, image blurring is often present in clinical picture acquisition processes. This is because of the inaccuracies imposed by the existence of scanners or motion blurring from a moving body. Therefore, we proposed a medical image fusion system that reduces the blurriness to get better results from MRI and CT scans. In the proposed methodology first, we pre-process medical images with deblurring algorithm to eliminate the blur. Further these pre-processed images are decayed into different sub-parts (base and information layer) using gaussian filter. Next choose maximum fusion law is used to integrate decomposed layers such that fused base and fused detail layers are obtained. Finally, a weighted sum law is applied to obtain the fusion result. Experimental analysis demonstrate that proposed method outperform other compared methodology visually and objectively.

articleTitle: Influential Nodes in online Social Network: A Principal Component Centrality based Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Social Network analysis starts with the identification of most influential nodes. However, it is always necessary to define centrality which is used for the creation of central node within the network and the type of transactional information being done within the network. In this paper, we identify influential nodes and hubs which are socially important, the nodes at the center of network is identified as most influential node in social networks which generally generate data online using principal component centrality (PCC). Hence, in order to establish the relationship and the comparison between principal component centrality with eigen vector and eigen value data (EVC), the actual measurement of node influence by integrity of their position in a network. We have taken data set from Kaggle and experiment was done on this dataset for online social network.

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Work Posture and Musculoskeletal Disorder Risk Level Identification for the Fireworks Industry Worker's
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the Firework industries, workers are affected by muscle, nerve, spinal cord, leg pain, or ligament injuries depending on the work nature and work pressure. During the festival or seasonal times, workers are forced to complete their tasks. For that period, supervisors and managers are likely to add to some tasks or increase their workload. They must work for longer durations and use excess hand and arm muscles, resulting in poor body posture. Musculoskeletal disorder (MSD) develops, as a result, causing pain and discomfort. But this may expose workers to workplace musculoskeletal conditions that lead to health complications and financial losses if endured over time. The current study objective is to find musculoskeletal disorder issues among the firework industry employees. Use the KNN rule to analyze the connection between musculoskeletal pain issues and risk factors, as well as work postures. The model will classify the poses supported that predicting the kind of disorder with accuracy and effectiveness. The results is used as a decision support tool to prioritize resources that can reduce ergonomic risk.

articleTitle: Bug Report Classification by Selecting Relevant Features Using Chi Square, Information Gain and Latent Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In machine learning, feature selection is a very important step to reduce the dimensionality of data by removing irrelevant features, redundant data to improve the learning accuracy. As the dimensionality of data has increased, feature selection has become a challenging task. Various approaches have been proposed for feature selection. In this study, we have analyzed the effectiveness of three widely used feature selection methods namely Chi square; information gain and latent semantic analysis (LSA) to classify the software bugs. The performance of four classifiers K nearest neighbor, Random Forest, naïve bayes and support vector machine are evaluated for the above feature selection methods in terms of accuracy, precision and recall.

articleTitle: Stress Measurement System Based on Heart Rate, Galvanic Skin Response and Electromyogram using IOT
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Stress is a major problem in today's society which needs to be addressed. Stress can cause many health problems and has a major impact in our lives. Mobile technology use has grown drastically over the years in the healthcare field. This paper presents a model which is used to detect and measure the stress level based on the data obtained from different sensors. Heart rate variance, Galvanic skin response and Electromyogram are measured from their respective sensor and then the stress level is determined from the data obtained and the obtained data are send to the mobile application using the Wi-Fi module.

articleTitle: A Probability Based Joint-Clustering Algorithm for Application Placement in Fog-to-Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Internet-of- Things (loT) becomes more prevalent in our lives, and more data-intensive, delay-sensitive, and real-time applications are expected to emerge. Fog computing has been seen as one of the main enablers for running applications. Appropriate service placement is necessary to host the services. The main challenging in choosing placement is to minimize service latency and energy consumption. This paper introduces the probability-based joint-clustering algorithm for clustering the fog nodes based on application requirements, which helps select those fog nodes. The proposed algorithm will allow a node to be included in more than one cluster. The proposed algorithm is compared with K-Means, random-disjoint, and random-joint. The empirical outcomes proofs that the proposed scheme outperforms the existing plans according to response time and energy utilization.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for pre-miRNA prediction: Current Challenges and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Micro RNAs (miRNAs) are small non coding RNA sequences that incriminated in numerous biological, anatomical processes and diseases. miRNAs are generally consisting of 20~23 nucleotides. miRNAs govern the post transcriptional expression of genes in both normal and disease condition of the cell. Thus, identification of miRNAs in the RNA sequence becomes crucial for understanding disease pathogenesis. Because of its short length, it is of-ten difficult to distinguish a mature miRNA from other non-coding RNA sequences. Thus, researchers aim at identifying precursor miRNAs (pre-miRNAs). Deep Learning is a part of broader family of machine learning methods which is inspired by artificial neural networks (ANN). By effective-ly deploying large data sets, deep learning has shown promising results in the field of visual computing and natural language processing. Now it tends to be a preferred method for various modeling tasks in omics research. In this re-view different emerging deep learning architectures and their applications in pre-miRNA prediction are outlined. A concise description of each study and various open challenges specific to pre-miRNA discovery has been present-ed. This study provides a research direction and perspective on future developments on emerging deep learning models for precise identification of miRNAs.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Android App To Shoot Prefab on Scanned Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today world we surrounded by technology. AR technology is now being used in a lot of field like education, health care, entertainment, gaming, military simulation, modular design and military training simulation. Big tech giants like google, apple, Facebook are in race to create the best and immersive Augmented Reality. They provide us the platform like ARCore by google, ARKit by apple and AR Studio by Facebook. Unity integrated with ARCore with inbuild feature like motion tracking, lighting, environmental awareness we can easily created our own app.

articleTitle: Education and Gender Empowerment
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Education is the most important weapon to change and improves one's life. Being educated is a benefit that can assist our people in creating a better society. There are many barriers averting women to follow and finish their education which is ultimately limiting women”s empowerment. Education is a critical component of women's empowerment, growth, wellbeing, and fortune. Women face insurmountable inequalities in all aspects of their lives; they must be empowered in all aspects of their lives. Through this paper, the authors have made an attempt to study the impact of education on women empowerment along with the measures taken by the Government of India for safeguarding the interest of women.

articleTitle: Estimation of SHG and LE-O Susceptibilities of InAs Crystal: Linear Absorption Taken into Account
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: We applied a model involving two coupled anharmonic oscillators (electronic and ionic)to estimate the Second Harmonic Generation (SHG) and Linear Electro-Optic (LE-O) susceptibilities of InAs crystal. The crystal of InAs belongs to III-V group compounds owing cubic zinc-blende-type structure. Linear absorption is considered for the selected spectral region 1250 nm – 390 nm. So, the contribution of the imaginary part of the involved complex linear ionic susceptibility to the resultant SHG and LE-O susceptibilities is taken into account and hence the absolute value of complex-linear ionic susceptibility i.e. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \chi_{i}^{(1)}(\omega)\vert$</tex>, is used in place of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\chi_{i}^{(1)}(\omega)$</tex> in the computation of SHG and LE-O coefficients. All of the four constants (nonlinear strength factors), appearing in the model, are determined with the help of experimental data of SHG susceptibility measured in the selected region of 1076 nm – 535 nm. Application of such calculated nonlinear strength factors in the concerned modelled expressions, SHG and LE-O susceptibility coefficients are computed as a function of frequency to illustrate the dispersion in the region of 1250 nm – 390 nm.

articleTitle: Android Controlled Field Tractor
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Majority of population in India is dependent on agriculture. Various activities like seed growing, ploughing, watering the field, grass cutting etc are performed in the agricultural field. The current scenario of these activities are difficult and time consuming. The methodologies used for this process are inconvenient and expensive to deal. So, such system should be encouraged in the field of agricultural in India which reduced time and manpower. This system aims to design and develop of the android controlled field tractor which can perform various field activities like sow the seeds, cutting the grass, and spraying the pesticides, this complete process is operated using Android App sends the signals to the device for required mechanisms and movement of the field tractor. By using this system, it increases the efficiency of pesticide spraying, seed sowing, and grass cutting and reduces the problem encountered in manual planting. A farmer has to do a lot of hard work in the agricultural field every day and without any method to avoid the direct rays of sunlight which is very irritating and distracting. So this system will help a farmer to sit in shade and control his tractor to perform various agricultural activities that are done in an agricultural field.

articleTitle: Stateless Zone Base Routing Protocol for Mobile Ad hoc Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In Mobile Ad hoc Wireless Sensor Network, mobility of nodes leads to path breakage which needs rerouting of packets via another path otherwise packets will be dropped. This results in delay or loss of packets. SPEED [2] is a QoS based protocol but it does not consider energy constraint and mobility. ZBR [1] is a reactive and energy efficient zone-based routing protocol for mwsn which is not suitable for real time communication. Therefore, we propose an energy efficient QoS based protocol for real time communication in mobile wsn. In this stateless routing protocol, forwarding nodes are selected on the basis of the node's residual energy, mobility and relay speed thus increasing the network lifetime and providing better quality of service. Simulation experiments of the proposed protocol were carried out on ns3.

articleTitle: Artificially Intelligent, Automatic, Modular Health Check Door to Ensure Safety against Covid - 19 and Other Epidemics
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the current scenario, where the fear of contracting the novel coronavirus is still there, the establishments like government offices, airports, business complexes and malls are slowly coming back to operations, for resuming and running the economic activities in the country. But the situation calls for a more ‘less-contact’ and ‘dedicated intelligent system’ to check the health vitals and status of individuals before permitting them to the concerned establishments or place and store the information/data, that can be used by the authorities or govt bodies in future. We are introducing a novel solution in the form of a modular and artificially intelligent glass door (“DOCTOR DOOR”) which performs some health checks on the individuals, before permitting them to the concerned premises.

articleTitle: Blockchain for IoT Security and Privacy
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is increasing day by day as time is succeeding continuously. A rapid improvement is seen in the research and industrial area, yet it meets all promises of security that could be used to mislead it in a wrong way. Security as well as protection approaches are not able to be applied for IoT purpose, mostly because of not having any central area of command and that's the most important rule of most of the devices. Blockchain which supports the secret computer codes i.e., Bitcoin can be used to give security and protection to different distributed systems that is used to serve comparison between things used in IoT. In many cases Blockchain are computer based and expensive too, yet they include high ability of transmission to hold something and to also delay putting something which is not reasonable for any IoT devices. This paper proposes a basic structure of blockchain technology that can be used to improve security and privacy to manage IoT devices and different networks. IoT which is considered as identifying someone's identity is done through servers by leading the privacy and security concern. There are chances of less reliable data, false verification and spoofing in data sharing. IoT security and privacy concerns are mainly challenged because of its massive distribution of networks in all sectors

articleTitle: Challenges and Opportunities for Unikernels in Machine Learning Inference
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Machine Learning has become a value creator for many new and old businesses. However, efficient realworld machine learning deployments are still a challenge. Traditional Machine Learning deployments suffer from efficient resource utilization and achieving predictable latency. They cannot be treated in the same manner as other application server deployments. Unikernels are a method to specialize application deployment and performance to suit the needs of the application. Traditionally, building or porting applications to unikernels have been challenging. However, recent work has been into simplifying the development of unikernels. Real-world Unikernels as of now are only for specializing applications that run on the CPU. We survey machine learning practitioners and find out that the majority of machine learning practitioners are using the CPU for machine learning deployments, thus, creating an opportunity for unikernels to optimize the performance of these applications. We compare the architecture of two unikernels: nanos and Unikraft. We benchmarked scikit-learn, a popular machine library, inside a unikernel and found that it only offered a 1% advantage over a traditional deployment. However, our testing could not include more innovative systems like Unikraft due to their immaturity and inability to run machine learning libraries. We include a dependency analysis of three popular machine learning libraries Tensorflow Lite, PyTorch and ONNX, to help pave the way for building machine learning applications as Unikraft unikernels.

articleTitle: Development of Android App-based Portable Water Quality Testing Device using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Availability of safe drinking water is crucial for nurturing human life on earth. Most of health problems arises due to the pollutant air and unhygienic water. water scarcity tends to human. Water contamination evolves stomach and health related problems, which overall effects the social life and development. The contaminated water is accelerating the microbial growth. This bacterial growth can be degraded with certain ranges of water quality parameters, mainly temperature, pH, and turbidity. These parameters generally measured in laboratories or costly equipment, and real time monitoring and data acquisition is tedious job. Presented work is to develop a cheap and portable android app-based water quality testing device which will help determine the water quality. The device is used to measure pH, Total dissolved Solid (TDS), and temperature initially, then information sent to Arduino based control unit. This device can be connected to mobile via Bluetooth, then android based mobile app shows the real time test data and record it for further analysis.

articleTitle: A Simple Algorithm for Fuzzy Time Minimizing Bulk Transportation Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In literature, various methods have been devised so far for solving bulk transportation problem (BTP). All the methods concentrate on BTP having demand, availability, cost, time etc. as crisp values. But, in physical problems, time of transportation is hardly precise due to various factors. BTP with time minimizing objective in fuzzy environment has not been studied so far to the best of our knowledge. Motivated by this gap in research, a BTP in fuzzy parameters is considered. In this work, fuzzy sets are employed for handling various situations of uncertainty in optimization problems related to decision making in BTP. In the considered problem, requirement and supply of the goods are precise but the time of transportation is not precise. A method is devised to minimize entire fuzzy time of BTP and is illustrated through an example.

articleTitle: Weighted Active Learning Paradigm based on GA and SVM for Pattern Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This article acquaints a new generalized weighted active learning paradigm to classify patterns based on nature inspired phenomena and is competent when abundant of unlabeled data is present whereas labelled data is scarce. In literature, most informative samples are selected in successive iterations of active learning model depends on either uncertainty or diverse measures or both but sequentially. Study showed that the unsettled and distinct samples both are equally important to improve learning at every run and can be used simultaneously. To resolve the selection based on uncertainty and diversity measures sequentially, this article utilizes genetic algorithm (GA) which select the most informative samples based on real fact that uncertainty and diversity measures does not play equal role and can be utilized simultaneously. Thus, to improve the selection at successive iterations, decision maker (analyst) may give the preference in the form of weight vector to select the most uncertain as well as non-redundant samples. The proposed technique is verified and validated with four different standard UCI repository datasets: Ionosphere, Iris, Pima, and Vehicle. The comparative results numerically prove that the proposed technique is efficient over existing techniques in terms of average overall classification (OA), 94.85% for Ionosphere, 89.89% for Iris, 71.87% for Pima, and 65.63% for Vehicle. The low number of initial training samples and graphical results also prove that the proposed weighted active learning technique is reliable, adaptive and robust.

articleTitle: Antenna Array System with Enhanced Gain Using Cross Dipole for the LTE
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The Proposed MIMO array design is presented for the LTE application. An antenna in the orthogonal formation with the conventional and modified features of STDA has been investigated for the performance identification for the S-parameters, mutual coupling, gain and directivity, and radiation pattern. Conventional STDA's has been taken into account of reference for the design methodology. Cross geometry of orthogonal structure has been introduced with the conventional STDA concept, for the achieving of stable gain in broaden bandwidth.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance Enhancement Of Electric Vehicle Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Modeling and simulation of Electric Vehicles has garnered increased attention from researchers as Electric Vehicles become a promising solution for sustainable and cleaner energy discharge in transportation. The aim of this research work ‘Dynamic Performance enhancement of Electric Vehicle Drive’ is to construct an electric vehicle drive model using a PI controller with the assistance of a simulation tool, which in this work is MATLAB Simulink. This model examines power flow in regenerative motoring using a standard electric vehicle drive configuration. For detailed input load conditions, this model can be used to evaluate the electric drive's power flow and proficiency. Some of the most important factors were listed, while others were depicted as ideal. The system quality and power flow were governed using a Simulink model that was constructed and then utilised to control a set of driving and regeneration speed and torque conditions. This study is to seem into the power flow calculation in order that the quantity of electricity is in accordance with the requirements of electrical vehicle.

articleTitle: Tracking and Tracing Proxy Enabled Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 9th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Under most conditions, digital hoodlums will submit deceitful exchanges utilizing intermediary administrations which conceal their genuine IP address and actual area. This is done with an end goal to try not to be followed and arraigned by law implementation offices. This paper presents the digital solution which will identify the proxy enabled systems with source ip address including tracing and tracking features. This paper explores the various hardware/software requirements for the proposed model and analyses the scope and future prospects of the model.
